units.zh: 劉蕡，字去華，幽州昌平人，客梁、汴間。
units.en: Liu Fen, whose courtesy name was Quhua, came from Changping in Youzhou and had long resided as a guest in the Liang and Bian regions.
units.literal: Liu Fen, styled Quhua, was a native of Changping in Youzhou, and lived as a guest in the regions of Liang and Bian.

units.zh: 明《春秋》，能言古興亡事，沈健於謀，浩然有救世意。
units.en: He mastered the Spring and Autumn Annals, could speak at length on the rise and fall of ancient states, was steady and resolute in planning, and carried within him a vast determination to rescue the age.
units.literal: He was versed in the Spring and Autumn Annals, could discourse on the rise and fall of states in antiquity, was composed and firm in counsel, and bore a grand resolve to save the world.

units.zh: 擢進士第。
units.en: He passed the jinshi civil examination.
units.literal: He was advanced to the jinshi degree.

units.zh: 元和後，權綱馳遷，神策中尉王守澄負弒逆罪，更二帝不能討，天下憤之。
units.en: After the Yuanhe period the axes of power shifted violently; Wang Shoucheng, the Shence Army commandant, carried the guilt of regicide, yet two successive emperors could not bring him to account, and the empire seethed with outrage.
units.literal: After the Yuanhe era, the pivots of power shifted rapidly; Wang Shoucheng, Commandant of the Divine Stratagem Army, bore the crime of regicide, yet through two emperors he could not be punished, and all under Heaven raged against it.

units.zh: 文宗即位，思洗元和宿恥，將翦落支黨。
units.en: When Emperor Wenzong came to the throne, he meant to wash away the old humiliation of the Yuanhe years and to cut down their factional networks.
units.literal: When Emperor Wenzong took the throne, he thought to wash away the long-standing shame of the Yuanhe era and intended to prune away their factional branches.

units.zh: 方宦人握兵，橫制海內，號曰「北司」，兇醜朋挻，外脅群臣，內掣侮天子，蕡常痛疾。
units.en: Meanwhile the eunuchs held the armies and lorded it over the realm under the name "Northern Office"; brutal and hideous, they swarmed in factions, outwardly intimidating the officials and inwardly restraining and humiliating the Son of Heaven — a wrong Fen felt as a constant wound.
units.literal: At the time eunuchs held the armies and tyrannized the realm, called the "Northern Office"; vicious and ugly, they banded together in gangs, outwardly coercing the ministers, inwardly restraining and insulting the Son of Heaven — Fen was often consumed with bitter grief.

units.zh: 大和二年，舉賢良方正能直言極諫，帝引諸儒百餘人於廷，策曰：
units.en: In the second year of Taihe he was nominated for the Worthy and Upright examination with license to speak frankly and remonstrate without reserve; the Emperor called more than a hundred scholars to court and set this policy question:
units.literal: In the second year of Taihe, he was recommended as Worthy and Upright, able to speak frankly and remonstrate to the utmost; the Emperor summoned more than a hundred scholars to court and posed this examination question:

units.zh: 朕聞古先哲王之治也，玄默無為，端拱司契，陶氓心以居簡，凝日用於不宰，厚下以立本，推誠而建中，繇是天人通，陰陽和，俗躋仁壽，物無疵癘。
units.en: I have heard that the ancient sage-kings governed in deep silence and without contrivance, sitting upright while they held the seals of rule; they shaped the people's hearts toward simplicity and gathered the day's business into non-interference; they enriched those below to lay the foundation and extended sincerity to build the Mean — and so Heaven and humanity were in accord, yin and yang harmonized, custom rose to benevolence and long life, and nothing suffered flaw or plague.
units.literal: I have heard that in the governance of the ancient sage-kings, they were profound and silent, non-active; sitting upright they held the tallies; they molded the hearts of the people toward simplicity, concentrated daily affairs into non-interference; they enriched those below to establish the foundation, extended sincerity to build the Mean — thereby Heaven and humanity communicated, yin and yang were in harmony, custom ascended to benevolence and longevity, and things were without blemish or pestilence.

units.zh: 噫！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 盛德之所臻，敻乎其不可及已。
units.en: The heights that supreme virtue reaches are so far beyond us that we cannot even approach them.
units.literal: What the utmost virtue attains — how remote and beyond our reach!

units.zh: 三代令主，質文叠救，百氏滋熾，風流浸微，自漢以降，足言蓋寡。
units.en: The enlightened rulers of the Three Dynasties saw substance and ornament rescue one another in turn, while the hundred schools swelled without restraint and refined culture slowly faded; from the Han onward, what is truly worth saying has grown ever thinner.
units.literal: The enlightened rulers of the Three Dynasties, substance and pattern succeeding each other in rescue — the hundred schools flourished excessively, refined culture gradually waned; from Han downward, what may fully be spoken of grows ever scant.

units.zh: 朕顧唯昧道，祗荷丕構，奉若謨訓，不敢怠荒，任賢惕厲，宵衣旰食，詎追三五之遐軌，庶紹祖宗之鴻緒。
units.en: Looking back, I see only how dim my grasp of the Way remains; reverently I shoulder this great edifice, heed the counsels of old, and dare not lapse into idleness; I place the worthy in office with vigilance, rise before dawn and eat after dusk, hoping to follow the far-off tracks of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors and to carry on the great thread of my ancestors' work.
units.literal: I look back and see only that the Way is obscure; reverently I bear the great structure, follow as if the counsels and instructions, and dare not be idle or negligent; I employ the worthy with vigilance, rise early and eat late, hoping to pursue the distant tracks of the Three and Five, and to continue the great thread of the ancestors.

units.zh: 而心有未達，行有未孚，由中及外，闕政斯廣。
units.en: Yet what I intend in the heart has not been realized, what I enact has not won trust; from within outward, the failures of government spread ever wider.
units.literal: Yet what is in the heart has not been attained, what is in conduct has not won trust; from within to without, gaps in governance grow wide.

units.zh: 是以人不率化，氣或堙厄，災旱竟歲，播植愆時。
units.en: For this reason the people do not follow our transforming influence, the vital energies are sometimes choked and distressed, drought and disaster run through the year, and sowing and planting fall out of season.
units.literal: Therefore the people do not follow transformation, the qi is sometimes blocked and distressed, disaster and drought last the whole year, sowing and planting miss their season.

units.zh: 國廩罕蓄，乏九年之儲；
units.en: The state granaries seldom fill, and we lack even the nine years' reserve;
units.literal: The state granaries rarely accumulate stores, lacking the nine years' reserve;

units.zh: 吏道多端，微三載之績。
units.en: the paths of officialdom branch in every direction, with scarcely three years of real achievement to show.
units.literal: the ways of officials are manifold, with scarcely three years' achievement.

units.zh: 京師，諸夏之本也，將以觀治，而豪猾逾檢；
units.en: The capital is the root of the realm, meant to display how we govern, yet the powerful and cunning overstep every restraint;
units.literal: The capital is the root of all the Xia, meant to display governance, yet the powerful and cunning overstep all bounds;

units.zh: 太學，明教之源也，期於變風，而生徒惰業。
units.en: the Imperial Academy is the fountainhead of enlightened teaching, where we look for custom to change, yet the students are slack in their work.
units.literal: the Imperial Academy is the source of enlightened teaching, expected to transform custom, yet students are idle in their studies.

units.zh: 列郡在乎頒條，而幹禁或未絕；
units.en: the commanderies depend on issuing regulations, yet breaches of prohibition are not ended;
units.literal: the commanderies depend on promulgating regulations, yet violations of prohibition are not ended;

units.zh: 百工在乎按度，而淫巧或未息。
units.en: the hundred crafts depend on keeping to standards, yet extravagant artifice has not been stilled.
units.literal: the hundred crafts depend on observing standards, yet extravagant artifice is not stilled.

units.zh: 俗恬風靡，積訛成蠹。
units.en: Custom has grown complacent and fashion dissolute; errors piled up have turned into rot.
units.literal: Custom is complacent, fashion dissolute; accumulated error becomes corruption.

units.zh: 其擇官濟治也，聽人以言則枝葉難辨，禦下以法則恥格不形；
units.en: In choosing officials to aid governance, if we listen only to men's words the branches and leaves are hard to tell apart; if we control subordinates by law alone, shame and restraint never take visible form;
units.literal: In selecting officials to aid governance, if one listens to men's words then branches and leaves are hard to distinguish; if one controls subordinates by law then shame and regulation do not take form;

units.zh: 其阜財發號也，生之寡而食之眾，煩於令而鮮于治。
units.en: in enriching the treasury and issuing commands, producers are few and consumers many; ordinances multiply while real governance grows rare.
units.literal: in enriching wealth and issuing commands, those who produce are few while those who consume are many; we are troubled by ordinances yet seldom attain good governance.

units.zh: 思所以究此繆盩，致之治平，茲心浩然，若涉淵冰。
units.en: I search for how to probe this confusion and bring the realm to peace; my heart is vast with care, as though I were walking over deep ice.
units.literal: I think how to investigate this confusion and disorder and bring it to peace and order; this heart is vast, as if treading deep ice.

units.zh: 故前詔有司，博延群彥，佇啟宿懵，冀臻時雍。
units.en: Therefore I earlier commanded the offices to gather the assembled worthies, awaiting that they dispel long-held ignorance and bring the age to harmony.
units.literal: Therefore I previously commanded the offices to broadly extend invitation to the assembled worthies, awaiting that they open long-stored ignorance, hoping to reach the harmony of the age.

units.zh: 子大夫皆識達古今，誌在康濟，造廷待問，副朕虛懷，必當箴治之闕，辨政之疵，明綱條之致紊，稽富庶之所急。
units.en: You gentlemen all understand past and present, your hearts set on bringing peace to the realm; you come to court to await my questions and to meet my open mind — you must point out what is lacking in governance, distinguish flaws in policy, show where statutes fall into disorder, and examine what the people urgently need for prosperity.
units.literal: You, gentlemen, all understand and penetrate past and present, your will set on bringing peace and aid; coming to court to await questioning, matching my open mind — you must admonish the gaps in governance, distinguish the flaws in policy, clarify where statutes and regulations fall into disorder, and examine what wealth and population urgently need.

units.zh: 何施革於前弊？
units.en: What measures will reform the abuses of the past?
units.literal: What measures shall reform former abuses?

units.zh: 何澤惠於下土？
units.en: What bounty will reach the people below?
units.literal: What bounty shall benefit the lower realm?

units.zh: 何脩而治古可近？
units.en: What cultivation will bring the governance of antiquity within reach?
units.literal: What cultivation shall make governance of antiquity attainable?

units.zh: 何道而和氣克充？
units.en: What Way will fully fill the realm with harmonious qi?
units.literal: What Way shall make harmonious qi fully fill?

units.zh: 推之本源，著於條對。
units.en: Trace each matter to its root and set it forth in your written replies.
units.literal: Trace it to the root source and set it forth in itemized answers.

units.zh: 至若夷吾輕重之權，孰輔於治？
units.en: As for Guan Zhong's power to weigh light and heavy, which of these aids governance?
units.literal: As for Guan Yiwu's power over light and heavy, which shall aid governance?

units.zh: 嚴尤底定之策，孰葉於時？
units.en: Yan You's policies for securing the realm — which accord with our times?
units.literal: Yan You's policies for securing the foundation — which accord with the times?

units.zh: 元凱之考課何先？
units.en: In the performance review of Yuan Kai, what should come first?
units.literal: In the performance review of Yuan Kai, what comes first?

units.zh: 叔子之克平何務？
units.en: In Shuzi's achievement of peace, what is the essential task?
units.literal: In Shuzi's achievement of peace, what is the task?

units.zh: 惟此龜鑒，擇乎中庸，斯在洽聞，朕將親覽。
units.en: Take these as your tortoise mirrors, choose the Mean among them; this depends on thorough knowledge — I shall read your answers myself.
units.literal: Only these tortoise mirrors — choose among the Mean; this lies in comprehensive hearing; I shall personally review.

units.zh: 蕡對曰：
units.en: Fen replied:
units.literal: Fen answered:

units.zh: 臣誠不佞，有正國致君之術，無位而不得行；
units.en: Your subject is truly without talent, yet possesses methods to set the state right and perfect the sovereign — but without office I cannot put them into practice;
units.literal: Your subject is truly without talent, yet has methods to rectify the state and bring the ruler to perfection, but without position cannot put them into practice;

units.zh: 有犯顏敢諫之心，無路而不得達。
units.en: I have a heart willing to offend your countenance and speak frankly, yet without a path my words cannot reach you.
units.literal: has a heart that offends the countenance and dares remonstrate, but without a path cannot reach you.

units.zh: 懷憤郁抑，思有時而發。
units.en: I bore my indignation pent up within, waiting for a moment when it might burst forth.
units.literal: Bearing indignation, depressed and suppressed, I thought there would be a time to release it.

units.zh: 常欲與庶人議於道、商賈謗於市，得通上聽，一悟主心，雖被襖言之罪無所悔。
units.en: I often wished to debate with commoners on the road and hear merchants voice criticism in the markets, so that word might reach your ears and awaken your heart once — even if condemned for seditious speech I would feel no regret.
units.literal: I often wished to discuss with commoners on the road, to have merchants speak slander in the markets, so that it might reach the ruler's ears and once awaken the sovereign's heart — even if condemned for heterodox speech I would not regret it.

units.zh: 況逢陛下詢求過闕，咨訪嘉謀，制詔中外，舉直言極諫。
units.en: How much more now, when Your Majesty inquires after faults and oversights, seeks excellent counsel, issues edicts throughout the realm, and calls for frank speech and utmost remonstrance.
units.literal: How much more now that I meet Your Majesty inquiring after faults and oversights, consulting for excellent counsel, issuing edicts within and without, and raising frank speech and utmost remonstrance.

units.zh: 臣辱斯舉，專承大問，敢不悉意以言？
units.en: Your subject is honored to be chosen for this, entrusted with your great question — how could I dare not speak with all my heart?
units.literal: Your subject is honored by this selection, solely receiving the great question — how dare I not exhaust my meaning in speech?

units.zh: 至於上所忌，時所禁，權幸所諱惡，有司所與奪，臣愚不識，伏惟陛下少加優容，不使聖時有讜言受戮者，天下之幸也。
units.en: As for what the sovereign taboos, what the age forbids, what the powerful and favored detest, what the offices control — your foolish subject cannot know them all; I beg Your Majesty to show a little gracious tolerance, that in this sage age no one who speaks forthrightly should die for it — that would be the fortune of the realm.
units.literal: As for what the sovereign taboos, what the times forbid, what the powerful and favored hate and avoid, what the offices grant and take away — your foolish subject does not know; I prostrate myself and beg Your Majesty to add a little gracious tolerance, that this sage age not have forthright words punished by death — this would be the fortune of all under Heaven.

units.zh: 謹昧死以對：
units.en: I respectfully risk death in answering:
units.literal: I respectfully risk death in answering:

units.zh: 伏以聖策有思古先之治，念玄默之化，將欲通天地以濟俗，和陰陽以煦物，見陛下慮道之深也。
units.en: I note that your sage question reflects on the governance of antiquity and the transformation of profound silence, intending to join Heaven and Earth to aid the people and harmonize yin and yang to warm all things — this shows how deeply Your Majesty ponders the Way.
units.literal: I prostrate myself: the sage examination question thinks on the governance of antiquity, recalls the transformation of profound silence, intends to connect Heaven and Earth to aid custom, harmonize yin and yang to warm things — this shows Your Majesty's deep concern for the Way.

units.zh: 臣以為哲王之治，其則不遠，惟致之之道何如耳。
units.en: I believe the standard of the wise king's governance is not far off; the question is only how to attain it.
units.literal: Your subject believes that the governance of the wise king — its standard is not far; only how the Way of attaining it is, that is all.

units.zh: 伏以聖策有祗荷丕構而不敢荒寧，奉若謨訓而罔有怠忽，見陛下憂勞之至也。
units.en: I note that your sage question shows you reverently bearing this great edifice without daring idleness, heeding the counsels of old without negligence — this shows the depth of Your Majesty's worry and labor.
units.literal: I prostrate myself: the sage question reverently bears the great structure and dares not be idle, follows as if the counsels and has no negligence — this shows Your Majesty's utmost worry and labor.

units.zh: 若夫任賢惕厲，宵衣旰食，宜絀左右之纖佞，進股肱之大臣。
units.en: As for employing the worthy with vigilance and rising before dawn to eat after dusk — you should dismiss the petty flatterers at your side and advance the great ministers who are your arms and thighs.
units.literal: As for employing the worthy with vigilance, rising early and eating late — one should dismiss the petty flatterers at left and right, and advance the great ministers who are the arms and thighs.

units.zh: 若夫追縱三五，紹復祖宗，宜鑒前古之興亡，明當代之成敗。
units.en: As for following the tracks of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors and continuing your ancestors' work — you should take as your mirror the rise and fall of former ages and see clearly the successes and failures of our own day.
units.literal: As for pursuing the tracks of the Three and Five and continuing the ancestors — one should take as mirror the rise and fall of former ages, and clarify the success and failure of the present age.

units.zh: 心有未達，以下情蔽而不得上通；
units.en: what the heart has not attained is because conditions below are blocked and cannot reach you;
units.literal: what the heart has not attained — because conditions below are blocked and cannot reach above;

units.zh: 行有未孚，以上澤壅而不得下浹。
units.en: what in conduct has not won trust is because your favor above is clogged and cannot soak the realm below.
units.literal: what in conduct has not won trust — because favor above is clogged and cannot soak below.

units.zh: 欲人之化，在脩己以先之；
units.en: If you wish the people to be transformed, cultivate yourself first to lead them;
units.literal: If you wish men to be transformed, cultivate the self first to lead them;

units.zh: 欲氣之和，在遂性以導之。
units.en: if you wish the vital energies to harmonize, follow their nature to guide them.
units.literal: if you wish the qi to be harmonious, follow their nature to guide them.

units.zh: 救災旱在致精誠，廣播殖在視食力。
units.en: Relief from drought and disaster lies in utmost sincerity; to broaden sowing and planting, look to the people's productive strength.
units.literal: To rescue from disaster and drought lies in extending utmost sincerity; to broaden sowing and planting lies in regarding food-producing strength.

units.zh: 國廩罕畜，本乎冗食尚繁；
units.en: that the state granaries seldom fill — the root cause is that redundant consumption remains too great;
units.literal: that state granaries rarely store grain — its root lies in redundant consumption still being abundant;

units.zh: 吏道多端，本乎選用失當。
units.en: that official paths branch in every direction — the root cause is mistaken selection and appointment.
units.literal: that the ways of officials are manifold — its root lies in selection and employment being wrong.

units.zh: 豪猾逾檢，繇中外之法殊；
units.en: that the powerful and cunning overstep bounds — because laws at court and in the provinces differ;
units.literal: that the powerful and cunning overstep bounds — because laws within and without differ;

units.zh: 生徒惰業，繇學校之官廢；
units.en: that students are slack in their studies — because school officials have been neglected;
units.literal: that students are idle in studies — because school officials are neglected;

units.zh: 列郡幹禁，繇授任非人；
units.en: that commanderies violate prohibitions — because the wrong men are appointed;
units.literal: that commanderies violate prohibitions — because appointments are not the right men;

units.zh: 百工淫巧，繇制度不立。
units.en: that the crafts turn to extravagant artifice — because institutions are not firmly established.
units.literal: that the hundred crafts are extravagant in artifice — because institutions are not established.

units.zh: 伏以聖策有擇官濟治之心，阜財發號之嘆，見陛下教化之本也。
units.en: I note that your sage question shows the heart to choose officials and aid governance, the sigh over enriching the treasury and issuing commands — this shows where Your Majesty's transforming work must begin.
units.literal: I prostrate myself: the sage question has the heart to select officials and aid governance, the sigh over enriching wealth and issuing commands — this shows Your Majesty's root of transforming and educating.

units.zh: 且進人以行，則枝葉安有難辨乎？
units.en: Moreover, if you advance men by their conduct, how could branches and leaves be hard to tell apart?
units.literal: Moreover, if you advance men by their conduct, how could branches and leaves be hard to distinguish?

units.zh: 防下以禮，則恥格安有不形乎？
units.en: If you guard subordinates with ritual, how could shame and restraint fail to take visible form?
units.literal: If you guard subordinates with ritual, how could shame and regulation fail to take form?

units.zh: 念生寡而食眾，可罷斥惰遊；
units.en: Seeing that producers are few and consumers many, dismiss the idle and wandering;
units.literal: Reflecting that producers are few and consumers many, dismiss the idle and wandering;

units.zh: 念令煩而治鮮，要察其行否。
units.en: seeing that ordinances multiply while governance grows rare, examine whether they are actually carried out.
units.literal: reflecting that ordinances are troublesome yet governance rare, examine whether they are carried out or not.

units.zh: 博延群彥，願陛下必納其言；
units.en: In broadly gathering the worthies, I beg Your Majesty to accept their words;
units.literal: Broadly extending the assembled worthies — I wish Your Majesty will surely accept their words;

units.zh: 造廷待問，則小臣安敢愛死？
units.en: in coming to court to await your questions, how could this petty subject dare hold back his life?
units.literal: coming to court to await questioning — how could this petty subject dare cherish his life?

units.zh: 伏以聖策有求賢箴闕之言，審政辨疵之令，見陛下咨訪之勤也。
units.en: I note that your sage question calls for seeking the worthy and admonishing what is lacking, for examining governance and distinguishing flaws — this shows how diligently Your Majesty consults.
units.literal: I prostrate myself: the sage question has words of seeking the worthy and admonishing gaps, orders to examine governance and distinguish flaws — this shows Your Majesty's diligence in consultation.

units.zh: 遂小臣斥奸豪之誌，則弊革於前；
units.en: if your subject then carries out his will to denounce treacherous grandees, former abuses will be reformed;
units.literal: if this petty subject then carries out the will to denounce treacherous grandees, former abuses will be reformed;

units.zh: 守陛下念康濟之心，則惠敷於下。
units.en: if I hold to Your Majesty's heart set on bringing peace to the realm, bounty will spread to the people below.
units.literal: if I keep Your Majesty's heart intent on bringing peace and aid, bounty will spread below.

units.zh: 邪正之道分，而治古可近；
units.en: if the paths of the wicked and the upright are divided, the governance of antiquity may be approached;
units.literal: if the paths of perverse and upright are divided, governance of antiquity may be approached;

units.zh: 禮樂之方著，而和氣克充。
units.en: if the methods of ritual and music are made manifest, harmonious qi can fully fill the realm.
units.literal: if the methods of ritual and music are made manifest, harmonious qi can fully fill.

units.zh: 至若夷吾之法，非皇王之權；
units.en: As for Guan Zhong's methods, they are not the authority of the sage-king;
units.literal: As for the methods of Yiwu, they are not the authority of the sage-king;

units.zh: 嚴尤所陳，無最上之策；
units.en: what Yan You presented offers no policy of the highest order;
units.literal: what Yan You presented has no policy of the highest order;

units.zh: 元凱之所先，不若唐堯考績；
units.en: what Yuan Kai puts first cannot match Tang Yao's performance review;
units.literal: what Yuan Kai puts first is not equal to Tang Yao's performance review;

units.zh: 叔子之所務，不若虞舜舞幹。
units.en: what Shuzi makes his task cannot match Yu Shun's dancing with shields and axes.
units.literal: what Shuzi makes his task is not equal to Yu Shun's dancing with shields.

units.zh: 且非大德之中庸、上聖之龜鑒，又何足為陛下道之哉？
units.en: Moreover, if they are not the Mean of great virtue or the tortoise mirror of the supreme sage, how are they worth mentioning to Your Majesty?
units.literal: Moreover, if they are not the Mean of great virtue or the tortoise mirror of the supreme sage, how are they worth speaking of to Your Majesty?

units.zh: 或有以系安危之機、兆存亡之變者，臣請披肝膽為陛下別白而重言之。
units.en: If there are matters that touch the pivot of security and danger and foretoken survival or extinction, I beg to lay bare my heart and speak of them plainly and at length for Your Majesty.
units.literal: If there are matters that bear on the pivot of security and danger, that foretoken the change of survival and extinction, your subject asks to lay bare liver and gall and for Your Majesty separately clarify and speak of them again with weight.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「哲王之治，其則不遠」者，在陛下慎思之、力行之、始終不懈而已。
units.en: What I meant when I said "the standard of the wise king's governance is not far" is simply that Your Majesty must think on it carefully, practice it vigorously, and never slacken from beginning to end.
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "the governance of the wise king — its standard is not far" lies in Your Majesty carefully thinking on it, vigorously practicing it, from beginning to end without slackening — that is all.

units.zh: 謹按《春秋》：元者，氣之始也；
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: yuan is the beginning of qi;
units.literal: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: yuan is the beginning of qi;

units.zh: 春者，歲之元也。
units.en: spring is the beginning of the year.
units.literal: spring is the yuan of the year.

units.zh: 《春秋》以元加於歲，以春加於王，明王者當奉若天道，以謹其始也。
units.en: The Spring and Autumn adds yuan to the year and spring to the king — showing that the king must follow Heaven's Way and be scrupulous at the beginning.
units.literal: The Spring and Autumn adds yuan to the year and spring to the king — making clear that the king should follow as if the Way of Heaven, to be careful at the beginning.

units.zh: 又舉時以終歲，舉月以終時，《春秋》雖無事，必書首月以存時，明王者當承天之道，以謹其終也。
units.en: Again it raises the season to conclude the year and the month to conclude the season — though the Annals record no events, they always note the first month to preserve the season, showing that the king must undertake Heaven's Way and be scrupulous at the end.
units.literal: Again it raises the season to conclude the year, raises the month to conclude the season — though the Spring and Autumn has no events, it must record the first month to preserve the season, making clear that the king should undertake Heaven's Way, to be careful at the end.

units.zh: 王者動作終始必法於天者，以其運行不息也。
units.en: The king's actions at beginning and end must take Heaven as their model because Heaven's movement never ceases.
units.literal: That the king's actions in beginning and end must take Heaven as model — is because its movement never ceases.

units.zh: 陛下能謹其始，又能謹其終，懋而脩之，勤而行之，則執契而居簡，無為而不宰，廣立本之大業，崇建中之盛德，安有三代循環之弊，百偽滋熾之漸乎？
units.en: If Your Majesty can be scrupulous at the beginning and at the end, strive to cultivate yourself and practice diligently, then holding the seals while dwelling in simplicity, acting without contrivance yet never failing to govern, broadly establishing the foundation's great work and exalting the flourishing virtue of the Mean — how could the cycling abuses of the Three Dynasties or the gradual spread of a hundred falsities remain?
units.literal: If Your Majesty can be careful at the beginning and careful at the end, striving to cultivate and diligently practicing, then holding the tallies while dwelling in simplicity, non-active yet not failing to govern, broadly establishing the great enterprise of the foundation, exalting the flourishing virtue of the Mean — how could there be the cycling abuses of the Three Dynasties or the gradual advance of a hundred falsities flourishing?

units.zh: 臣故曰：「唯致之之道何如耳。」
units.en: I therefore say again: "The question is only how to attain it."
units.literal: Your subject therefore says: "Only how the Way of attaining it is — that is all."

units.zh: 臣前所謂「若夫任賢惕厲，宵衣旰食，宜絀左右之纖佞，進股肱之大臣」，實以陛下憂勞之至也。
units.en: What I meant when I said "you should employ the worthy with vigilance, rise before dawn and eat after dusk, dismiss the petty flatterers at your side, and advance your great ministers as arms and thighs" — is that Your Majesty's worry and labor have reached an extreme.
units.literal: What your subject earlier said — "As for employing the worthy with vigilance, rising early and eating late, one should dismiss the petty flatterers at left and right and advance the great ministers who are the arms and thighs" — is in truth because Your Majesty's worry and labor reach the utmost.

units.zh: 臣聞不宜憂而憂者，國必衰；
units.en: I have heard that when a ruler worries over what he should not worry about, the state must decline;
units.literal: Your subject has heard: when one worries over what one should not worry about, the state must decline;

units.zh: 宜憂而不憂者，國必危。
units.en: when a ruler fails to worry over what he should worry about, the state must be in peril.
units.literal: when one does not worry over what one should worry about, the state must be in peril.

units.zh: 陛下不以國家存亡、社稷安危之策而降於清問，臣未知陛下以布衣之臣不足與定大計耶？
units.en: Your Majesty does not lower your clear inquiry to policies for the state's survival, the realm's security and danger — I do not know whether Your Majesty thinks a man in plain cloth insufficient to settle the great plan?
units.literal: Your Majesty does not lower clear inquiry with policies for the state's survival or extinction, the altar of soil and grain's security or danger — your subject does not know whether Your Majesty thinks a subject in plain cloth insufficient to settle the great plan?

units.zh: 或萬機之勤有所未至也？
units.en: Or is it that your diligence over the myriad affairs has not yet reached everywhere?
units.literal: Or is it that diligence over the myriad affairs has not yet reached everywhere?

units.zh: 不然，何宜憂而不憂乎？
units.en: If not, why do you fail to worry over what you should worry about?
units.literal: If not, why do you not worry over what you should worry about?

units.zh: 臣以為陛下所先憂者，宮闈將變，社稷將危，天下將傾，四海將亂。
units.en: I believe what Your Majesty should worry over first is this: the inner palace is about to change, the altars of state are about to be endangered, the realm is about to topple, and the four seas are about to fall into chaos.
units.literal: Your subject believes what Your Majesty should worry over first: the inner palace is about to change, the altar of soil and grain is about to be in peril, all under Heaven is about to topple, the four seas are about to fall into chaos.

units.zh: 此四者，國家已然之兆，故臣謂聖慮宜先及之。
units.en: These four are omens already manifest in the state; therefore I say Your Majesty's concern should reach them first.
units.literal: These four are already-manifest omens of the state; therefore your subject says the sage consideration should reach them first.

units.zh: 夫帝業艱難而成之，固不可容易而守之。
units.en: The imperial enterprise was won only with difficulty; it certainly cannot be held with ease.
units.literal: The imperial enterprise was achieved with difficulty; it certainly cannot be guarded with ease.

units.zh: 太祖肇其基，高祖勤其績，太宗定其業，玄宗繼其明，至於陛下，二百餘載，其間聖明相因，擾亂繼作，未有不用賢士、近正人而能興者。
units.en: Taizu laid its foundation, Gaozu labored at its achievements, Taizong fixed its enterprise, Xuanzong continued its brilliance — down to Your Majesty, more than two hundred years have passed; through that span sage rulers succeeded one another and turmoil followed in turn — never yet has a dynasty flourished without employing worthy men and drawing near the upright.
units.literal: Taizu laid its foundation, Gaozu labored at its achievements, Taizong fixed its enterprise, Xuanzong continued its brilliance — down to Your Majesty, more than two hundred years; in that interval sage brilliance succeeded one another, disturbance and chaos followed in succession — never has there been one who, without employing worthy scholars and drawing near upright men, could flourish.

units.zh: 或一日不念，則顛覆大器，宗廟之恥，萬古為恨。
units.en: Neglect it for a single day and the great vessel is overturned — shame upon the ancestral temples, a regret for ten thousand ages.
units.literal: If for a single day you do not think on it, the great vessel is overturned, the shame of the ancestral temples — for ten thousand ages a regret.

units.zh: 臣謹按《春秋》，人君之道，在體元以居正。
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: the ruler's Way lies in embodying the beginning to dwell in correctness.
units.literal: Your subject respectfully examines the Spring and Autumn Annals: the Way of the ruler lies in embodying yuan to dwell in correctness.

units.zh: 昔董仲舒為漢武帝言之略矣，有未盡者，臣得為陛下備論之。
units.en: Long ago Dong Zhongshu spoke of it to Emperor Wu of Han in outline; what he left unsaid, your subject may now set forth fully for Your Majesty.
units.literal: Formerly Dong Zhongshu spoke of it to Emperor Wu of Han in summary; what was not exhausted, your subject may fully discuss for Your Majesty.

units.zh: 夫繼故必書即位，所以正其始也；
units.en: In succeeding a predecessor, the Annals must record enthronement — thereby to set the beginning right;
units.literal: In succeeding the former, one must record enthronement — thereby to correct the beginning;

units.zh: 終必書所終之地，所以正其終也。
units.en: At the end one must record where it ends — thereby to set the conclusion right.
units.literal: At the end one must record the place where it ends — thereby to correct the end.

units.zh: 故為君者，所發必正言，所履必正道，所居必正位，所近必正人。
units.en: Therefore for a ruler: what he speaks must be upright words, what he walks must be the upright Way, where he dwells must be the upright position, and whom he draws near must be upright men.
units.literal: Therefore for one who is ruler: what he issues must be upright words, what he treads must be the upright Way, where he dwells must be the upright position, whom he draws near must be upright men.

units.zh: 《春秋》：「閽弒吳子余祭。」
units.en: The Spring and Autumn Annals records: "A gate guard murdered Prince Yuji of Wu."
units.literal: The Spring and Autumn Annals: "A gate guard murdered Prince Yuji of Wu."

units.zh: 書其名，譏疏遠賢士，昵刑人，有不君之道。
units.en: It records his name, condemning how he kept worthy scholars at a distance, favored mutilated men, and conducted himself unlike a true ruler.
units.literal: It records his name, condemning how he kept worthy scholars at a distance, was intimate with mutilated men, and had the conduct of one who is not a ruler.

units.zh: 伏惟陛下思祖宗開國之勤，念《春秋》繼故之誡。
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to reflect on the toil of the ancestors in founding the state and heed the Spring and Autumn's admonition on succeeding a predecessor.
units.literal: I prostrate myself and beg Your Majesty to think on the toil of the ancestors in founding the state, and recall the admonition of the Spring and Autumn on succeeding the former.

units.zh: 明法度之端，則發正言，履正道；
units.en: Clarify the foundations of law and institution, then speak upright words and walk the upright Way;
units.literal: Clarify the beginning of laws and institutions, then issue upright words and tread the upright Way;

units.zh: 杜篡弒之漸，則居正位，近正人。
units.en: block the gradual advance of usurpation and regicide, then dwell in the upright position and draw near upright men.
units.literal: block the gradual advance of usurpation and regicide, then dwell in the upright position and draw near upright men.

units.zh: 遠刀鋸之殘，親骨鯁之直，輔相得以顓其任，庶寮得以守其官。
units.en: Keep far from the cruelty of torture, draw near the blunt integrity of true remonstrators; then chief ministers can fully carry out their duties and the myriad offices can keep to their posts.
units.literal: Keep far the cruelty of blade and saw, draw near the straightness of those who are bone in the throat; then chief ministers can fully carry out their duties, and the myriad offices can keep to their posts.

units.zh: 奈何以褻近五六人總天下大政，外專陛下之命，內竊陛下之權，威懾朝廷，勢傾海內，群臣莫敢指其狀，天子不得制其心，禍稔蕭墻，奸生帷幄，臣恐曹節、侯覽復生於今日，此宮闈將變也。
units.en: Yet how can five or six men of intimate proximity monopolize the great affairs of the realm — outwardly monopolizing your commands, inwardly stealing your authority, their might terrifying the court and their power overturning the empire; the ministers dare not point to their conduct, the Son of Heaven cannot control their hearts; disaster ripens within the courtyard wall and treachery arises within the curtain — I fear Cao Jie and Hou Lan are reborn in our day: this is the inner palace about to change.
units.literal: Yet how can five or six men of intimate proximity monopolize the great affairs of all under Heaven — outwardly monopolizing Your Majesty's commands, inwardly stealing Your Majesty's authority, their might terrifying the court, their power overturning the realm; the hundred ministers dare not point to their conduct, the Son of Heaven cannot control their hearts; disaster ripens within the courtyard wall, treachery arises within the curtain — your subject fears Cao Jie and Hou Lan are reborn in our day: this is how the inner palace is about to change.

units.zh: 臣謹按《春秋》：「定公元年春王。」
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: "In spring of the first year of Duke Ding, the King."
units.literal: Your subject respectfully examines the Spring and Autumn Annals: "In spring of the first year of Duke Ding, the King."

units.zh: 不言正月者，《春秋》以為先君不得正其終，則後君不得正其始，故曰「定無正」也。
units.en: It does not speak of the first month because the Annals hold that if the former ruler could not set his end right, the later ruler cannot set his beginning right — therefore it says "Ding has no correctness."
units.literal: It does not speak of the first month because the Spring and Autumn holds that if the former ruler could not correct his end, then the later ruler cannot correct his beginning — therefore it says "Ding has no correctness."

units.zh: 今忠賢無腹心之寄，閽寺專廢立之權，陷先帝不得正其終，致陛下不得正其始，況太子未立，郊祀未脩，將相之職不歸，名器之宜不定，此社稷將危也。
units.en: Now the loyal and worthy have no trust at your side; gatekeepers and eunuchs monopolize the power to depose and establish, trapping the former emperor so he could not set his end right and causing you not to set your beginning right — moreover the heir is not established, suburban sacrifices are not performed, the duties of generals and ministers do not return to their places, and titles and regalia are not fixed: this is how the altars of state are about to be endangered.
units.literal: Now the loyal and worthy have no trust of heart and belly; gatekeepers and eunuchs monopolize the power to depose and establish, trapping the former emperor so he could not correct his end, causing Your Majesty not to correct your beginning — moreover the heir is not established, suburban sacrifices not performed, the duties of generals and ministers do not return to their places, the appropriateness of titles and vessels is not fixed: this is how the altar of soil and grain is about to be in peril.

units.zh: 臣謹按《春秋》：「王劄子殺召伯、毛伯。」
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: "Prince Zha of Zhou murdered the Earl of Shao and the Earl of Mao."
units.literal: Your subject respectfully examines the Spring and Autumn Annals: "Prince Zha of Zhou murdered the Earl of Shao and the Earl of Mao."

units.zh: 《春秋》之義，兩下相殺不書。
units.en: The principle of the Annals: when two sides kill each other, it is not recorded.
units.literal: The principle of the Spring and Autumn: when two sides kill each other, it is not recorded.

units.zh: 此書者，重其顓王命也。
units.en: That it is recorded here emphasizes how he monopolized the royal command.
units.literal: That it is recorded here emphasizes how he monopolized the king's command.

units.zh: 夫天之所授者在命，君之所存者在令。
units.en: What Heaven bestows lies in the mandate; what the ruler preserves lies in his commands.
units.literal: What Heaven bestows lies in the mandate; what the ruler preserves lies in commands.

units.zh: 操其命而失之者，是不君也；
units.en: to grasp the mandate yet lose it — that is not to be a ruler;
units.literal: to grasp the mandate yet lose it — that is not being a ruler;

units.zh: 侵其命而專之者，是不臣也。
units.en: to encroach on the mandate and monopolize it — that is not to be a minister.
units.literal: to encroach on the mandate and monopolize it — that is not being a minister.

units.zh: 君不君，臣不臣，此天下所以將傾也。
units.en: When the ruler is no ruler and the minister no minister — this is why the realm is about to topple.
units.literal: The ruler not a ruler, the minister not a minister — this is why all under Heaven is about to topple.

units.zh: 臣謹按《春秋》，晉趙鞅以晉陽之兵叛入於晉，書其歸者，能逐君側之惡以安其君，故《春秋》善之。
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: Zhao Yang of Jin led the troops of Jinyang in rebellion and entered Jin; the Annals record his return because he drove out the wicked at the ruler's side to secure his lord — therefore the Annals commend him.
units.literal: Your subject respectfully examines the Spring and Autumn Annals: Zhao Yang of Jin led the troops of Jinyang in rebellion and entered Jin; it records his return because he was able to drive out the wicked at the ruler's side to secure his ruler — therefore the Spring and Autumn commends him.

units.zh: 今威柄陵夷，藩臣跋扈。
units.en: Now royal authority declines and frontier lords grow overbearing.
units.literal: Now authority declines, frontier lords are overbearing.

units.zh: 有不達人臣大節，而首亂者將以安君為名；
units.en: there are those who do not comprehend a minister's great integrity, yet those who first raise chaos will take securing the ruler as their pretext;
units.literal: there are those who do not comprehend the great integrity of a minister, yet those who first raise chaos will take securing the ruler as their name;

units.zh: 不究《春秋》之微，稱兵者在逐惡為義。
units.en: without investigating the subtlety of the Annals, those who raise armies will claim that driving out the wicked is righteous.
units.literal: not investigating the subtlety of the Spring and Autumn, those who raise armies will take driving out the wicked as righteousness.

units.zh: 則典刑不繇天子，征伐必自諸侯，此海內之將亂也。
units.en: then canonical punishments will not come from the Son of Heaven and campaigns will necessarily come from the feudal lords — this is how the empire is about to fall into chaos.
units.literal: then canonical punishments will not come from the Son of Heaven, campaigns and punishments will necessarily come from the feudal lords — this is how the realm within the seas is about to fall into chaos.

units.zh: 故樊噲排闥而雪涕，袁盎當車而抗辭，京房發憤以殞身，竇武不顧而畢命，此皆陛下明知之矣。
units.en: Therefore Fan Kuai pushed through the door with tears streaming, Yuan Ang blocked the carriage with defiant words, Jing Fang gave vent to indignation and lost his life, Dou Wu paid no heed and gave his life — all these Your Majesty clearly knows.
units.literal: Therefore Fan Kuai pushed through the door with tears streaming, Yuan Ang blocked the carriage with defiant words, Jing Fang gave vent to indignation and lost his life, Dou Wu paid no heed and ended his life — all these Your Majesty clearly knows.

units.zh: 臣謹按《春秋》，晉狐射姑殺陽處父，書襄公殺之者，以其君漏言也。
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: Hu Shegu of Jin murdered Yang Chufu; the Annals record that Duke Xiang murdered him because his ruler leaked a secret.
units.literal: Your subject respectfully examines the Spring and Autumn Annals: Hu Shegu of Jin murdered Yang Chufu; it records that Duke Xiang murdered him because his ruler leaked words.

units.zh: 襄公不能固陰重之機，處父所以及殘賊之禍，故《春秋》非之。
units.en: Duke Xiang could not keep a weighty secret; Chufu therefore met a cruel end — therefore the Annals condemn it.
units.literal: Duke Xiang could not secure the secret weighty occasion; Chufu therefore met the disaster of cruel injury — therefore the Spring and Autumn condemns it.

units.zh: 夫上漏其情，則下不敢盡意；
units.en: When those above leak their feelings, those below dare not speak their full intent;
units.literal: When those above leak their feelings, those below dare not exhaust their intent;

units.zh: 上泄其事，則下不敢盡言。
units.en: when those above disclose their affairs, those below dare not speak their full mind.
units.literal: when those above disclose their affairs, those below dare not exhaust their words.

units.zh: 故《傳》有造膝詭辭之文，《易》有失身害成之戒。
units.en: Therefore the Commentary has texts of knee-to-knee deceptive words, and the Changes warns of losing one's person and harming what is accomplished.
units.literal: Therefore the Commentary has texts of knee-to-knee deceptive words, and the Changes has the warning of losing one's person and harming what is accomplished.

units.zh: 今公卿大臣，非不欲為陛下言之，慮陛下不能用也。
units.en: Now the great ministers — it is not that they do not wish to speak to you; they fear you cannot employ their words.
units.literal: Now the great ministers and high officials — it is not that they do not wish to speak to Your Majesty; they fear Your Majesty cannot employ their words.

units.zh: 忽而不用，必泄其言，臣下既言而不行，必嬰其禍；
units.en: if you suddenly do not employ them, they will surely leak their words; if subordinates speak yet nothing is done, they will surely meet disaster;
units.literal: if suddenly not employed, they will surely leak their words; if subordinates have spoken yet it is not carried out, they will surely meet with disaster;

units.zh: 適足鉗直臣之口，而重奸臣之威。
units.en: this only clamps shut the mouths of upright ministers and adds weight to the might of treacherous ministers.
units.literal: this only clamps shut the mouths of upright ministers and adds weight to the might of treacherous ministers.

units.zh: 是以欲盡其言則有失身之懼，欲盡其意則有害成之憂，裴回郁塞，以須陛下感悟，然後盡其啟沃。
units.en: Therefore if they wish to speak fully they fear for their lives; if they wish to speak their full mind they worry of harming what is accomplished; they hesitate, depressed and blocked, awaiting your awakening — only then do they fully offer their counsel.
units.literal: Therefore if they wish to exhaust their words they have the fear of losing their person; if they wish to exhaust their intent they have the worry of harming what is accomplished; they turn and hesitate, depressed and blocked, awaiting Your Majesty's awakening — only then do they fully offer their nourishing counsel.

units.zh: 陛下何不聽朝之餘，時禦便殿，召當世賢相老臣，訪持變扶危之謀，求定傾救亂之術，塞陰邪之路，屏褻狎之臣，制侵陵迫脅之心，復門戶掃除之役，戒其所宜戒，憂其所宜憂。
units.en: Why do you not, after court affairs, from time to time proceed to the side hall, summon the worthy chief ministers and elder statesmen of the age, inquire after plans to uphold change and support peril, seek methods to settle what topples and rescue chaos, block the paths of perverse influence, dismiss intimate favorites, restrain hearts that encroach and coerce, restore the work of sweeping clear the gates and households, warn against what should be warned, and worry over what should be worried?
units.literal: Why does Your Majesty not, after hearing court affairs, from time to time proceed to the convenient hall, summon the worthy chief ministers and elder statesmen of the age, inquire after plans to uphold change and support peril, seek methods to settle what topples and rescue chaos, block the paths of yin perversity, dismiss intimate and familiar ministers, restrain hearts that encroach and coerce, restore the work of sweeping clear the gates and households, warn against what should be warned, worry over what should be worried?

units.zh: 既不得治其前，當治於後；
units.en: If you cannot set right what came before, set right what comes after;
units.literal: If you cannot govern what came before, govern what comes after;

units.zh: 不得正其始，當正其終。
units.en: if you cannot set the beginning right, set the end right.
units.literal: if you cannot correct the beginning, correct the end.

units.zh: 則可以虔奉典謨，克承丕構，終任賢之效，無宵旰之憂矣。
units.en: Then you can reverently follow the canonical counsels, fully inherit the great edifice, finally achieve the effect of employing the worthy, and be free of the worry of rising before dawn and eating after dusk.
units.literal: Then you can reverently follow the canonical counsels, fully inherit the great structure, finally achieve the effect of employing the worthy, and be without the worry of rising early and eating late.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「追縱三五，紹復祖宗，宜鑒前古之興亡，明當時之成敗」者。
units.en: What I meant when I said "you should follow the tracks of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors and continue your ancestors' work — take as your mirror the rise and fall of former ages and see clearly the successes and failures of our own time."
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "pursuing the tracks of the Three and Five, continuing the ancestors — one should take as mirror the rise and fall of former ages, clarify the success and failure of the present time."

units.zh: 臣聞堯、禹之為君而天下大治者，以能任九官、四嶽、十二牧，不失其舉，不貳其業，不侵其職，居官唯其能，左右唯其賢，元凱在下雖微而必舉，四兇在朝雖強而必誅，考其安危，明其取舍。
units.en: I have heard that Yao and Yu brought the realm to great order because they could employ the Nine Officers, the Four Peaks, and the Twelve Pastors — never missing the right appointment, never duplicating tasks, never encroaching on duties; in office only by ability, at their side only the worthy; worthy men below though slight were always raised, the Four Evils in court though strong were always executed; they examined security and danger and clarified what to take and what to discard.
units.literal: Your subject has heard that Yao and Yu as rulers brought all under Heaven to great order because they could employ the Nine Officers, the Four Peaks, and the Twelve Pastors — not missing the right appointment, not duplicating their tasks, not encroaching on their duties; in office only according to ability, at left and right only the worthy; the Yuan and Kai below though slight yet always raised, the Four Evils in court though strong yet always executed; examining security and danger, clarifying what to take and what to discard.

units.zh: 至秦二世、漢元成，鹹願措國如唐、虞，致身如堯、舜，而終敗亡者，以其不見安危之機，不知取舍之道，不任大臣，不辨奸人，不親忠良，不遠讒佞也。
units.en: As for Qin Ershi and the Han emperors Yuan and Cheng — all wished to set the state like Tang and Yu and make themselves like Yao and Shun, yet in the end were defeated and perished — because they did not see the pivot of security and danger, did not know what to take and what to discard, did not employ great ministers, did not distinguish treacherous men, did not draw near the loyal, and did not keep far from slanderous flatterers.
units.literal: As for Qin Ershi and the Han emperors Yuan and Cheng — all wished to set the state like Tang and Yu, make their persons like Yao and Shun, yet in the end were defeated and perished — because they did not see the pivot of security and danger, did not know the Way of taking and discarding, did not employ great ministers, did not distinguish treacherous men, did not draw near the loyal and good, did not keep far from slanderous flatterers.

units.zh: 伏惟陛下察唐、虞之所以興，而景行於前；
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to examine why Tang and Yu flourished and take their bright conduct as your model;
units.literal: I prostrate myself and beg Your Majesty to examine why Tang and Yu flourished, and take their bright conduct as model before you;

units.zh: 鑒秦、漢之所以亡，而戒懼於後。
units.en: take as your mirror why Qin and Han perished and be warned and fearful thereafter.
units.literal: take as mirror why Qin and Han perished, and be warned and fearful thereafter.

units.zh: 陛下無謂廟堂無賢相，庶官無賢士，今紀綱未絕，典刑猶在，人誰不欲致身為王臣，致時為升平？
units.en: Your Majesty must not say the court has no worthy chief minister or the offices no worthy scholar — the statutes are not yet severed and canonical punishments still exist; who among men does not wish to serve as your minister and bring the age to peace?
units.literal: Your Majesty must not say the temple hall has no worthy chief minister, the myriad offices no worthy scholar — now the statutes are not yet severed, canonical punishments still exist; who among men does not wish to devote his person as the king's minister, devote the age to ascending peace?

units.zh: 陛下何忽而不用邪？
units.en: Why do you suddenly not employ them?
units.literal: Why does Your Majesty suddenly not employ them?

units.zh: 又有居官非其能，左右非其賢，惡如四兇，詐如趙高，奸如恭、顯，陛下何憚而不去邪？
units.en: Moreover there are those in office beyond their ability, at your side not the worthy — wicked as the Four Evils, deceitful as Zhao Gao, treacherous as Gong and Xian — why do you shrink from removing them?
units.literal: Moreover there are those in office not according to their ability, at left and right not the worthy — wicked as the Four Evils, deceitful as Zhao Gao, treacherous as Gong and Xian — why does Your Majesty shrink from removing them?

units.zh: 神器固有歸，天命固有分，祖宗固有靈，忠臣固有心，陛下其念之哉！
units.en: The sacred vessel has its rightful place, the mandate of Heaven has its allotment, the ancestors have their spirits, loyal ministers have their hearts — Your Majesty, think on these!
units.literal: The sacred vessel inherently has its return, the mandate of Heaven inherently has its allotment, the ancestors inherently have their spirits, loyal ministers inherently have their hearts — Your Majesty, think on these!

units.zh: 昔秦之亡也，失於強暴；
units.en: Formerly Qin perished through violent severity;
units.literal: Formerly Qin's perishing was lost through violent severity;

units.zh: 漢之亡也，失於微弱。
units.en: Han perished through feebleness.
units.literal: Han's perishing was lost through feebleness.

units.zh: 強暴則奸臣畏死而害上，微弱則強臣竊權而震主。
units.en: Violent severity makes treacherous ministers fear death and harm their superiors; feebleness lets powerful ministers steal authority and shake their lord.
units.literal: Violent severity then treacherous ministers fear death and harm their superiors; feebleness then powerful ministers steal authority and shake their lord.

units.zh: 臣伏見敬宗不虞亡秦之禍，不翦其萌。
units.en: I see that Emperor Jingzong did not guard against Qin's disaster, did not cut away its sprout.
units.literal: Your subject prostrate sees that Emperor Jingzong did not guard against Qin's disaster of perishing, did not cut away its sprout.

units.zh: 伏惟陛下深軫亡漢之憂，以杜其漸，則祖宗之洪業可紹，三五之遐軌可追矣。
units.en: I beg Your Majesty deeply to grieve Han's disaster and block its gradual advance — then the ancestors' great enterprise can be continued and the distant tracks of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors can be pursued.
units.literal: I prostrate myself and beg Your Majesty deeply to grieve Han's disaster of perishing, to block its gradual advance — then the ancestors' great enterprise can be continued, the distant tracks of the Three and Five can be pursued.

units.zh: 臣前所謂陛下「心有所未達，以下情塞而不能上通；
units.en: What I said earlier — Your Majesty, "what you intend in the heart has not been realized because conditions below are blocked and cannot reach you;
units.literal: What your subject earlier said — Your Majesty "what the heart has not attained, because conditions below are blocked and cannot reach above;

units.zh: 行有所未孚，以上澤壅而不得下浹」；
units.en: what you enact has not won trust because your favor above is clogged and cannot soak the realm below";
units.literal: what in conduct has not won trust, because favor above is clogged and cannot soak below";

units.zh: 且百姓有塗炭之苦，陛下無繇而知；
units.en: moreover the people suffer as if in fire and coals, yet you have no means to know;
units.literal: moreover the hundred surnames have the suffering of being in fire and coals, yet Your Majesty has no means to know;

units.zh: 陛下有子惠之心，百姓無繇而信。
units.en: Your Majesty has a heart of fatherly kindness, yet the people have no means to believe it.
units.literal: Your Majesty has a heart of fatherly kindness, yet the hundred surnames have no means to believe.

units.zh: 臣謹按《春秋》書「梁亡」不書「取」者，梁自亡也，以其思慮昏而耳目塞，上出惡政，人為寇盜，皆不知其所以，終自取其滅亡也。
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: it records "Liang perished" and does not record "taken" — Liang destroyed itself because its thought was muddled and its ears and eyes blocked, above issued wicked government and men became bandits, none knowing why — in the end it brought on its own extinction.
units.literal: Your subject respectfully examines the Spring and Autumn Annals: it records "Liang perished" and does not record "taken" — Liang destroyed itself, because its thought was muddled and ears and eyes blocked, above issued wicked government, men became bandits and robbers, none knew why — in the end it took its own extinction and perishing.

units.zh: 臣聞國君之所以尊者，重其社稷也；
units.en: I have heard that what makes a ruler honored is valuing his altars of state;
units.literal: Your subject has heard that what makes the ruler of a state honored is valuing his altar of soil and grain;

units.zh: 社稷之所以重者，存其百姓也。
units.en: what makes the altars valued is preserving the people.
units.literal: what makes the altar of soil and grain valued is preserving the hundred surnames.

units.zh: 茍百姓不存，則雖社稷不得固其重；
units.en: If the people do not survive, then even the altars cannot secure their weight;
units.literal: If the hundred surnames do not survive, then even the altar of soil and grain cannot secure its weight;

units.zh: 社稷不重，則人君不得保其尊。
units.en: if the altars are not valued, then the ruler cannot preserve his honor.
units.literal: if the altar is not valued, then the ruler of men cannot preserve his honor.

units.zh: 故治天下者，不可不知百姓之情。
units.en: Therefore one who governs the realm cannot fail to know the feelings of the people.
units.literal: Therefore one who governs all under Heaven cannot fail to know the feelings of the hundred surnames.

units.zh: 夫百姓者，陛下之赤子，陛下宜令慈仁者視育之，如保傅焉，如乳哺焉，如師之教導焉。
units.en: The people are Your Majesty's infants; you should have the kind and benevolent regard and nurture them — as a guardian and tutor, as nursing with milk, as a teacher's instruction and guidance.
units.literal: The hundred surnames are Your Majesty's red infants; Your Majesty should have the kind and benevolent regard and nurture them — as a guardian and tutor, as nursing with milk, as a teacher's instruction and guidance.

units.zh: 故人之於上也，恭之如神明，愛之如父母。
units.en: Therefore men's attitude toward those above should be: revering them as spirits, loving them as parents.
units.literal: Therefore men's attitude toward those above: revering them as spirits, loving them as parents.

units.zh: 今或不然，陛下親近貴幸，分曹建署，補除卒吏，召致賓客，因其貨賄，假以聲勢；
units.en: Now it is perhaps not so: you draw near the honored and favored, divide offices and establish bureaus, appoint and dismiss clerks, summon guests — relying on their bribes and lending them reputation and power;
units.literal: Now it is perhaps not so: Your Majesty draws near the honored and favored, divides offices and establishes bureaus, supplements and dismisses clerks and officers, summons and receives guests — relying on their goods and bribes, lending them reputation and power;

units.zh: 大者統藩方，小者為守牧，居上無清惠之政而有饕餮之害，居下無忠誠之節而有奸欺之罪。
units.en: the great ones command frontier regions, the small ones serve as prefects and governors — above there is no clear and gracious government but the harm of gluttonous greed; below there is no loyalty but the crime of treachery and deceit.
units.literal: the great ones command frontier regions, the small ones serve as prefects and governors — above there is no clear and gracious government but the harm of gluttonous beasts; below there is no integrity of loyalty but the crime of treachery and deceit.

units.zh: 故人之於上也，畏之如豺狼，惡之如仇敵。
units.en: Therefore men's attitude toward those above becomes: fearing them as jackals and wolves, hating them as enemies.
units.literal: Therefore men's attitude toward those above: fearing them as jackals and wolves, hating them as enemies.

units.zh: 今海內困窮，處處流散，饑者不得食，寒者不得衣，鰥寡孤獨不得存，老幼疾病不得養，加以國權兵柄顓於左右，貪臣聚斂以固寵，奸吏因緣而弄法，冤痛之聲，上達於九天，下入於九泉，鬼神為之怨怒，陰陽為之愆錯。
units.en: Now the empire is distressed and impoverished, people scatter everywhere — the hungry cannot obtain food, the cold cannot obtain clothing, widowers and orphans cannot survive, the old and sick cannot be cared for; added to this, state authority and military power are monopolized by those at your side, greedy ministers gather levies to secure favor, treacherous officials seize opportunities to manipulate the law — cries of wrongful pain reach up to the nine heavens and sink down to the nine springs; spirits and ghosts are angered, yin and yang are disordered.
units.literal: Now within the seas there is distress and poverty, everywhere scattering and dispersal — the hungry cannot obtain food, the cold cannot obtain clothing, widowers and orphans cannot survive, old and young, sick and diseased cannot be nourished; added to this, state authority and military power are monopolized by those at left and right, greedy ministers gather levies to secure favor, treacherous officials seize opportunities to manipulate the law — cries of wrongful pain reach up to the nine heavens, sink down to the nine springs; spirits and ghosts are angered by it, yin and yang are disordered by it.

units.zh: 君門萬重，不得告訴，士人無所歸化，百姓無所歸命。
units.en: The ruler's gate is ten thousand layers deep — they cannot lodge complaints; scholars have nowhere to turn, the people have nowhere to place their trust.
units.literal: The ruler's gate is ten thousand layers deep — they cannot lodge complaints; scholars have nowhere to turn for transformation, the hundred surnames have nowhere to turn for their mandate.

units.zh: 官亂人貧，盜賊並起，土崩之勢，憂在旦夕。
units.en: Officials in chaos, people in poverty, bandits rising together — the momentum of earth collapsing, worry within morning and evening.
units.literal: Officials in chaos, people in poverty, bandits and robbers rising together — the momentum of earth collapsing, worry within morning and evening.

units.zh: 即不幸因之以病癘，繼之以兇荒，陳勝、吳廣不獨起於秦，赤眉、黃巾不獨生於漢，臣所以為陛下發憤扼腕、痛心泣血也。
units.en: If misfortune adds plague upon this, followed by fierce famine — Chen Sheng and Wu Guang did not arise only in Qin, the Red Eyebrows and Yellow Turbans did not arise only in Han; this is why I vent indignation for you, clutch my wrist in anguish, and grieve to the point of weeping blood.
units.literal: If misfortune adds plague upon this, followed by fierce famine — Chen Sheng and Wu Guang did not arise only in Qin, the Red Eyebrows and Yellow Turbans did not arise only in Han; this is why your subject for Your Majesty vents indignation, clutches his wrist, grieves to the heart and weeps blood.

units.zh: 如此則百姓有塗炭之苦，陛下何繇而知之乎？
units.en: If it is thus, the people suffer as if in fire and coals — how can you have means to know?
units.literal: If it is thus, the hundred surnames have the suffering of fire and coals — how can Your Majesty have means to know?

units.zh: 陛下有子惠之心，百姓安得而信之乎？
units.en: Your Majesty has a heart of fatherly kindness — how can the people obtain belief in it?
units.literal: Your Majesty has a heart of fatherly kindness — how can the hundred surnames obtain belief in it?

units.zh: 使陛下行有所未孚，心有所未達，固其然也。
units.en: That your conduct has not won trust and what you intend has not been realized — it is solidly so.
units.literal: That Your Majesty's conduct has not won trust, what the heart has not attained — it is solidly so.

units.zh: 臣聞漢元帝即位之初，更制七十餘事，其心甚誠，其稱甚美。
units.en: I have heard that at the beginning of Emperor Yuan of Han's accession, he changed more than seventy institutions — his heart was very sincere, his reputation very fine.
units.literal: Your subject has heard that at the beginning of Emperor Yuan of Han's accession, he changed more than seventy institutions — his heart was very sincere, his reputation very fine.

units.zh: 然紀綱日紊，國祚日衰，奸宄日強，黎元日困，繇不能擇賢明而任之，失其操柄也。
units.en: Yet day by day the statutes were tangled, day by day the dynastic fortune declined, day by day treacherous villains grew strong, day by day the people were distressed — because he could not select the worthy and employ them, he lost his grip on power.
units.literal: Yet day by day the statutes were tangled, day by day the dynastic fortune declined, day by day treacherous villains grew strong, day by day the black-haired people were distressed — because he could not select the worthy and bright and employ them, he lost his grip on the handle.

units.zh: 自陛下即位，憂勤兆庶，屢降德音，四海之內，莫不抗首而長息，自喜復生於死亡之中也。
units.en: Since your accession, worry and diligence for the myriad masses, repeatedly issuing virtuous pronouncements — throughout the four seas none failed to raise their heads and sigh with relief, rejoicing that they were reborn from among the dead.
units.literal: Since Your Majesty's accession, worry and diligence for the myriad masses, repeatedly issuing virtuous pronouncements — within the four seas none failed to raise their heads and sigh long, rejoicing that they were reborn from among the dead.

units.zh: 伏惟陛下慎終如始，以塞四方之望。
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to be careful at the end as at the beginning, to satisfy the hopes of the four directions.
units.literal: I prostrate myself and beg Your Majesty to be careful at the end as at the beginning, to satisfy the hopes of the four directions.

units.zh: 誠能揭國柄以歸於相，持兵柄以歸於將，去貪臣聚斂之政，除奸吏因緣之害，惟忠賢是近，惟正直是用，內寵便僻無所聽焉。
units.en: If you can truly return state authority to the chancellor and military authority to the generals, remove the government of greedy ministers gathering levies, eliminate the harm of treacherous officials seizing opportunities, draw near only the loyal and worthy and employ only the upright — hear none of the words of inner favorites and convenient flatterers.
units.literal: If you can truly raise the state's handle and return it to the chancellor, hold the military handle and return it to the generals, remove the government of greedy ministers gathering levies, eliminate the harm of treacherous officials seizing opportunities, draw near only the loyal and worthy, employ only the upright — inner favorites and convenient flatterers, none of their words heard.

units.zh: 選清慎之官，擇仁惠之長，敏之以利，煦之以和，教之以孝慈，導之以德義，去耳目之塞，通上下之情，俾萬國歡康，兆庶蘇息，即心無不達，而行無不孚矣。
units.en: Select officials who are clear and cautious, choose leaders who are benevolent and gracious, quicken them with benefit, warm them with harmony, teach them filial piety and kindness, guide them with virtue and righteousness, remove the blockage of ears and eyes, connect the feelings of above and below — then make the ten thousand states joyful and at peace and the myriad masses revive and rest; then what you intend will reach everywhere and what you enact will win trust everywhere.
units.literal: Select officials who are clear and cautious, choose leaders who are benevolent and gracious, quicken them with benefit, warm them with harmony, teach them with filial piety and kindness, guide them with virtue and righteousness, remove the blockage of ears and eyes, connect the feelings of above and below — then make the ten thousand states joyful and at peace, the myriad masses revive and rest; then what the heart intends will not fail to reach, what is enacted will not fail to win trust.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「欲人之化也，在脩己以先之」，臣聞德以脩己，教以導人。
units.en: What I said earlier — "if you wish the people to be transformed, cultivate yourself first to lead them" — I have heard: virtue is for cultivating the self, teaching is for guiding others.
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "if you wish men to be transformed, cultivate the self first to lead them" — your subject has heard: virtue is for cultivating the self, teaching is for guiding others.

units.zh: 脩之也，則人不勸而自立；
units.en: cultivate it, then men without exhortation stand of themselves;
units.literal: cultivate it, then men without exhortation stand of themselves;

units.zh: 導之也，則人不教而率從。
units.en: guide it, then men without teaching broadly follow.
units.literal: guide it, then men without teaching broadly follow.

units.zh: 君子欲政之必行也，故以身先之；
units.en: The noble man wishes government to be carried out, therefore he takes the lead with his own person;
units.literal: The noble man wishes government necessarily to be carried out, therefore he takes the lead with his person;

units.zh: 欲人之從化也，故以道禦之。
units.en: wishes men to follow transformation, therefore he governs them with the Way.
units.literal: wishes men to follow transformation, therefore he governs them with the Way.

units.zh: 今陛下先之以身而政未必行，禦之以道而人未從化，豈立教之旨未盡其方邪？
units.en: Now you take the lead with your person yet government is not necessarily carried out, govern with the Way yet men have not followed transformation — is it that the aim of establishing teaching has not exhausted its methods?
units.literal: Now Your Majesty takes the lead with your person yet government is not necessarily carried out, governs with the Way yet men have not followed transformation — is it that the aim of establishing teaching has not exhausted its methods?

units.zh: 夫立教之方，在乎君以明制之，臣以忠行之。
units.en: The method of establishing teaching lies in the ruler clearly regulating it and the minister loyally carrying it out.
units.literal: The method of establishing teaching lies in the ruler clearly regulating it, the minister loyally carrying it out.

units.zh: 君以知人為明，臣以正時為忠。
units.en: The ruler takes knowing men as clarity; the minister takes correcting the times as loyalty.
units.literal: The ruler takes knowing men as clarity; the minister takes correcting the times as loyalty.

units.zh: 知人在任賢而去邪，正時則固本而守法。
units.en: Knowing men lies in employing the worthy and removing the perverse; correcting the times lies in securing the foundation and keeping to the law.
units.literal: Knowing men lies in employing the worthy and removing the perverse; correcting the times lies in securing the foundation and keeping to the law.

units.zh: 賢不任則重賞不足以勸善，邪不去則嚴刑不足以禁非，本不固則人流，法不守則政散，而欲教之必至，化之必行，不可得也。
units.en: If the worthy are not employed, heavy rewards are insufficient to encourage good; if the perverse are not removed, severe punishments are insufficient to prohibit wrong; if the foundation is not secure, people scatter; if the law is not kept, government disperses — yet wishing teaching to arrive and transformation to be carried out cannot be obtained.
units.literal: If the worthy are not employed, heavy rewards are insufficient to encourage good; if the perverse are not removed, severe punishments are insufficient to prohibit wrong; if the foundation is not secure, people scatter; if the law is not kept, government disperses — yet wishing teaching necessarily to arrive and transformation necessarily to be carried out cannot be obtained.

units.zh: 陛下能斥奸邪而不私其左右，舉賢正而不遺其疏遠，則化浹朝廷矣。
units.en: If you can repel treacherous perversity without favoring those at your side, raise the worthy and upright without neglecting the distant — then transformation will soak the court.
units.literal: If Your Majesty can repel treacherous perversity without favoring those at left and right, raise the worthy and upright without neglecting the distant — then transformation will soak the court.

units.zh: 愛人而敦本，分職而奉法，脩其身以及其人，始於中而成於外，則化行天下矣。
units.en: Love others and enrich the foundation, divide duties and keep to the law, cultivate yourself and extend to others, begin within and accomplish without — then transformation will travel the realm.
units.literal: Love others and enrich the foundation, divide duties and keep to the law, cultivate the self and extend to others, begin within and accomplish without — then transformation will travel all under Heaven.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「欲氣之和也，在遂其性以導之」者，當納人於仁壽也。
units.en: What I said earlier — "if you wish the vital energies to harmonize, follow their nature to guide them" — one should bring the people into benevolence and longevity.
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "if you wish the qi to be harmonious, follow their nature to guide them" — one should bring men into benevolence and longevity.

units.zh: 夫欲人之仁壽也，在立制度，脩教化。
units.en: If one wishes the people benevolent and long-lived, it lies in establishing institutions and cultivating transformation.
units.literal: If one wishes men benevolent and long-lived, it lies in establishing institutions and cultivating transformation.

units.zh: 夫制度立則財用省，財用省則賦斂輕，賦斂輕則人富矣；
units.en: When institutions are established, expenditures are economized; when expenditures are economized, levies are light; when levies are light, the people grow wealthy;
units.literal: When institutions are established, expenditures are economized; when expenditures are economized, levies are light; when levies are light, men are wealthy;

units.zh: 教化脩則爭競息，爭競息則刑罰清，刑罰清則人安矣。
units.en: when transformation is cultivated, contention ceases; when contention ceases, punishments are clear; when punishments are clear, the people are at peace.
units.literal: when transformation is cultivated, contention ceases; when contention ceases, punishments are clear; when punishments are clear, men are at peace.

units.zh: 既富矣，則仁義興焉；
units.en: once wealthy, then benevolence and righteousness arise;
units.literal: once wealthy, then benevolence and righteousness arise;

units.zh: 既安矣，則壽考至焉。
units.en: once at peace, then longevity arrives.
units.literal: once at peace, then longevity arrives.

units.zh: 仁義之心感於下，和平之氣應於上，故災害不作，休祥存臻，四方底寧，萬物鹹遂矣。
units.en: Hearts of benevolence and righteousness are moved below, qi of peace and harmony respond above — therefore disasters do not arise, auspicious omens arrive, the four directions reach tranquility, and the ten thousand things all succeed.
units.literal: Hearts of benevolence and righteousness are moved below, qi of peace and harmony respond above — therefore disasters do not arise, auspicious omens arrive in succession, the four directions reach tranquility, and the ten thousand things all succeed.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「救災旱在乎致精誠」者。
units.en: What I said earlier — "relieving drought and famine lies in attaining utmost sincerity."
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "relieving drought disaster lies in attaining utmost sincerity."

units.zh: 臣謹按《春秋》，魯僖公一年之中，三書「不雨」者，以其人君有恤人之誌也；
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: within a single year of Duke Xi of Lu, "no rain" is recorded three times — because that ruler had a mind to care for the people;
units.literal: Your subject respectfully examines the Spring and Autumn Annals: within a single year of Duke Xi of Lu, thrice recording "no rain" — because that ruler had the purpose of caring for the people;

units.zh: 文公三年之中，一書「不雨」者，以其人君無閔人之心也。
units.en: across three years of Duke Wen, it is recorded only once as "no rain" — because that ruler had no heart of compassion for the people.
units.literal: within three years of Duke Wen, recording "no rain" once — because that ruler had no heart of compassion for the people.

units.zh: 故僖致誠而旱不害物，文無恤閔而變則成災。
units.en: Therefore when Xi attained sincerity, drought did not harm the crops; when Wen lacked care and compassion, a change in conditions became true disaster.
units.literal: Therefore Xi attained sincerity and drought did not harm things; Wen lacked care and compassion, and when change occurred it became disaster.

units.zh: 陛下有閔人之誌，則無成災之變矣。
units.en: If Your Majesty has a mind to care for the people, there will be no change that becomes disaster.
units.literal: If Your Majesty has the purpose of caring for the people, there will be no change that becomes disaster.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「廣播殖在乎視食力」者。
units.en: What I said earlier — "broad sowing and planting depend on observing the people's capacity to produce food."
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "broad sowing and planting lies in observing the people's capacity to produce food."

units.zh: 臣謹按《春秋》：「君人者必時視民之所勤。
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: "A ruler must constantly observe what the people labor at.
units.literal: Your subject respectfully examines the Spring and Autumn Annals: "One who rules the people must constantly observe what the people labor at.

units.zh: 民勤於力則功築罕，民勤於財則貢賦少，民勤於食則百事廢。」
units.en: When the people labor at physical strength, public works grow scarce; when they labor at wealth, tribute and levies shrink; when they labor at securing food, the hundred affairs are abandoned."
units.literal: When the people labor at strength, achievements and construction are rare; when they labor at wealth, tribute and levies are few; when they labor at food, the hundred affairs are abandoned."

units.zh: 今財食與力皆勤矣，願陛下廢百事之用，以廣三時之務，則播植不愆矣。
units.en: Today wealth, food, and strength are all overstrained. I beg Your Majesty to set aside the hundred affairs and broaden the work of the three farming seasons — then sowing and planting will not fail.
units.literal: Now wealth, food, and strength are all labored — your subject wishes Your Majesty to abandon the uses of the hundred affairs to broaden the duties of the three seasons, then sowing and planting will not fail.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「國廩罕蓄，本乎冗食尚繁」者。
units.en: What I said earlier — "the state's granaries hold little, because redundant consumption remains excessive."
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "the state's granaries rarely store — rooted in redundant consumption still being excessive."

units.zh: 臣謹按《春秋》：「臧孫辰告糴於齊。」
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: "Zangsun Chen requested grain from Qi."
units.literal: Your subject respectfully examines the Spring and Autumn Annals: "Zangsun Chen requested grain from Qi."

units.zh: 《春秋》譏其無九年之蓄，一年不登而百姓饑。
units.en: The Annals condemn him for lacking nine years' stores — one year of poor harvest and the common people went hungry.
units.literal: The Spring and Autumn Annals condemns him for lacking nine years' stores — one year of poor harvest and the hundred surnames hungered.

units.zh: 臣願斥遊惰之人以篤耕殖，省不急之費以贍黎元，則廩蓄不乏矣。
units.en: I beg to expel idle wanderers to deepen farming, cut non-urgent expenditures to nourish the people — then granary stores will not run dry.
units.literal: Your subject wishes to expel idle wanderers to solidify farming and planting, economize non-urgent expenditures to nourish the black-headed masses, then granary stores will not be lacking.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「吏道多端，本乎選用失當」者，繇國家取人不盡其材、任人不明其要故也。
units.en: What I said about "the officials' paths multiplying, rooted in wrongful selection and appointment" — this is because the state does not draw on men's full talents, and appointments do not clarify what truly matters.
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "the officials' Way is many-branched, rooted in selection and employment being inappropriate" — because the state does not take men's full talent, and employing men does not clarify the essentials.

units.zh: 今陛下之用人也，求其聲而不求其實，故人之趨進也，務其末而不務其本。
units.en: Today in appointing men, Your Majesty seeks reputation but not substance; therefore those who advance attend to show but not to substance.
units.literal: Now in Your Majesty's employment of men, you seek their reputation but not their substance; therefore in men's rushing forward, they attend to the branches but not the root.

units.zh: 臣願核考課之實，定遷序之制，則多端之吏息矣。
units.en: I beg to examine the substance of performance evaluations and fix the system of advancement — then the multiplied paths of officials will subside.
units.literal: Your subject wishes to examine and verify the substance of evaluations, fix the system of promotion and sequence, then the many-branched officials will cease.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「豪猾逾檢，繇中外之法殊」者，以其官禁不一也。
