units.en: What I said about "the powerful and cunning overstepping bounds, because inner and outer law differ" — this is because official prohibitions are not one.
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "overbearing and cunning men overstep bounds, because inner and outer laws differ" — because official prohibitions are not unified.

units.zh: 臣謹按《春秋》，齊桓公盟諸侯不日，而葵丘之盟特以日者，美其能宣明天子之禁，率奉王官之法，故《春秋》備而書之。
units.en: I respectfully examine the Spring and Autumn Annals: when Duke Huan of Qi covenanted with the feudal lords, dates were usually omitted; yet the covenant at Kuiqiu is specially dated — praising his ability to proclaim the Son of Heaven's prohibitions and lead the states in keeping to the royal laws; therefore the Annals record it in full.
units.literal: Your subject respectfully examines the Spring and Autumn Annals: when Duke Huan of Qi covenanted with the feudal lords, dates were not given; yet the covenant at Kuiqiu is specially dated — praising his ability to proclaim and clarify the Son of Heaven's prohibitions and lead in keeping to the royal officers' laws; therefore the Spring and Autumn Annals records it in full.

units.zh: 然則官者，五帝、三王之所建也；
units.en: Thus offices were what the Five Emperors and Three Kings established;
units.literal: Thus offices were what the Five Emperors and Three Kings established;

units.zh: 法者，高祖、太宗之所制也。
units.en: laws were what Gaozu and Taizong enacted.
units.literal: laws were what Gaozu and Taizong enacted.

units.zh: 法宜畫一，官宜正名。
units.en: Laws should be unified; offices should have correct titles.
units.literal: Laws should be drawn as one; offices should have corrected names.

units.zh: 今又分外官、中官之員，立南司、北司之局，或犯禁於南則亡命於北，或正刑於外則破律於中，法出多門，人無所措，繇兵農勢異，而中外法殊也。
units.en: Now again outer and inner officials are divided in posts, and Southern Bureau and Northern Bureau offices are established — violate a prohibition in the south and flee to the north; be punished outside and break the law within; laws issue from many gates and men have nowhere to turn — because military and agricultural power diverge, inner and outer law are separate.
units.literal: Now again outer officials and inner officials are divided in posts, Southern Bureau and Northern Bureau offices are established — if one violates prohibition in the south he flees to the north; if punished outside he breaks law within; laws issue from many gates and men have nowhere to set themselves — because military and agricultural power differ, inner and outer laws are separate.

units.zh: 臣聞古者因井田以制軍賦，間農事以脩武備，提封約卒乘之數，命將在公卿之列，故兵農一致，而文武同方，以保乂邦家，式遏亂略。
units.en: I have heard that in antiquity the well-field system regulated military levies, agricultural seasons were interwoven with military training, fiefs were tallied for chariot and foot numbers, and commanders were appointed from among the chief ministers — thus military and agriculture were one, civil and martial shared one direction, to secure the state and check rebellion.
units.literal: Your subject has heard that in antiquity, through well-field [land] they regulated military levies, interspersed agricultural affairs to cultivate military readiness, took fiefs and reckoned chariot-and-foot numbers, and commanders were placed among dukes and ministers — therefore military and agriculture were one, civil and martial shared one direction, to secure and govern the state and family and check rebellious designs.

units.zh: 太宗置府兵臺省軍衛，文武參掌，閑歲則櫜弓力穡，有事則釋耒荷戈，所以脩復古制，不廢舊物。
units.en: Taizong established the fubing militia, Terrace offices, and army guards — civil and martial jointly administered; in peaceful years they sheathed bows and labored in the fields; when trouble arose they set aside plows and took up arms — thereby restoring the ancient system without abandoning the old institutions.
units.literal: Taizong established fubing militia, Terrace offices, and army guards — civil and martial jointly administered; in idle years they sheathed bows and exerted strength at sowing; when affairs arose they set aside plows and shouldered spears — thereby restoring the ancient system without abandoning the old institutions.

units.zh: 今則不然。
units.en: Now it is not so.
units.literal: Now it is not so.

units.zh: 夏官不知兵籍，止於奉朝請；
units.en: the Minister of War does not know the military registers, and attends court only as a formality;
units.literal: the Minister of War does not know military registers, stopping at attending court audience;

units.zh: 六軍不主武事，止於養階勛。
units.en: the Six Armies do not preside over military affairs, and exist only to nurture ranks and honors.
units.literal: the Six Armies do not preside over military affairs, stopping at nurturing ranks and merit.

units.zh: 軍容合中官之政，戎律附內臣之職。
units.en: military affairs are merged with inner eunuch government; military regulations are attached to inner attendants' offices.
units.literal: military affairs merge with inner officials' government; military regulations attach to inner attendants' duties.

units.zh: 首一戴武弁，疾文吏如仇讎；
units.en: one head dons the military cap and hates civil officials like sworn enemies;
units.literal: one head dons the military cap and hates civil officials like sworn enemies;

units.zh: 足一蹈軍門，視農夫如草芥。
units.en: one foot steps through the army gate and regards farmers as nothing.
units.literal: one foot steps through the army gate and regards farmers like grass and husks.

units.zh: 謀不足以翦除奸兇，而詐足以抑揚威福；
units.en: their stratagems are insufficient to cut down treacherous villains, yet their cunning suffices to raise and lower authority and favor;
units.literal: their stratagems are insufficient to cut down treacherous villains, yet their cunning suffices to raise and lower authority and favor;

units.zh: 勇不足以鎮衛社稷，而暴足以侵害閭裏。
units.en: their courage is insufficient to guard the altars of state, yet their violence suffices to prey on lanes and hamlets.
units.literal: their courage is insufficient to guard and secure the altars of soil and grain, yet their violence suffices to invade lanes and hamlets.

units.zh: 羈紲藩臣，幹陵宰輔，隳裂王度，汩亂朝經。
units.en: They bind feudal ministers, overawe chief ministers, shatter the royal measure, and muddy the constants of court governance.
units.literal: They bind feudal ministers, overawe chief ministers, shatter the royal measure, and muddy and disorder court constants.

units.zh: 張武夫之威，上以制君父；
units.en: They display the might of warriors to control the ruler and father above;
units.literal: They display the might of warriors to control the ruler and father above;

units.zh: 假天子之命，下以禦英豪。
units.en: they borrow the Son of Heaven's command to repel heroes below.
units.literal: they borrow the Son of Heaven's command to repel heroes below.

units.zh: 有藏奸觀釁之心，無伏節死難之誼。
units.en: They harbor treachery and watch for openings, but have no principle of bowing to duty and dying in hardship.
units.literal: They have hearts that harbor treachery and watch for openings, but no principle of bowing to duty and dying in hardship.

units.zh: 豈先王經文緯武之旨邪！
units.en: Is this the purpose of the former kings in weaving civil and martial together!
units.literal: Is this the purpose of the former kings in weaving civil and martial!

units.zh: 臣願陛下貫文武之道，均兵農之功，正貴賤之名，一中外之法，還軍衛之職，脩省署之官；
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to thread civil and martial Ways together, equalize military and agricultural achievement, correct titles of noble and base, unify inner and outer law, restore the duties of army guards, and repair the provincial offices;
units.literal: Your subject wishes Your Majesty to thread through civil and martial Ways, equalize military and agricultural achievements, correct names of noble and base, unify inner and outer laws, restore army guards' duties, and repair provincial offices;

units.zh: 近崇貞觀之風，遠復成周之制：自邦畿以刑下國，始天子而達諸侯，可以制猾奸之強，無逾檢之患矣。
units.en: near at hand honor the spirit of the Zhenguan reign, far off restore the institutions of the accomplished Zhou: from the capital domain discipline the subordinate states, from the Son of Heaven down to the feudal lords — then you can restrain the strong among cunning villains, and there will be no calamity of overstepping bounds.
units.literal: near at hand honor the wind of the Zhenguan reign, far off restore the institutions of the accomplished Zhou: from the capital domain punish the subordinate states, beginning with the Son of Heaven and reaching the feudal lords — then one can restrain the strong among cunning villains, and there will be no calamity of overstepping bounds.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「生徒惰業，繇學校之官廢」者，蓋國家貴其祿，賤其能，先其事，後其行，故庶官乏通經之學，諸生無脩業之心矣。
units.en: What I said about "students growing idle because school offices are abandoned" — broadly the state values their stipends and despises their ability, puts position before conduct; therefore the myriad offices lack mastery of the classics, and students have no heart to cultivate their studies.
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "students are idle in study, because school officials are abandoned" — broadly the state values their stipends and despises their ability, puts affairs first and conduct last; therefore the myriad offices lack learning that penetrates the classics, and the students have no heart to cultivate study.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「列郡幹禁，繇授任非人」者，臣以為刺史之任，治亂之根本系焉，朝廷之法制在焉，權可以禦豪強，恩可以惠孤寡，強可以禦奸寇，政可以移風俗。
units.en: What I said about "the commanderies interfering with prohibitions because the wrong men are appointed" — I hold that the post of regional inspector is where the root of order and disorder lies and where the court's laws and institutions reside; with authority one can repel overbearing strongmen, with kindness benefit orphans and widows, with strength repel treacherous bandits, and with government shift customs and mores.
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "the commanderies interfere with prohibitions, because appointment is to unfit men" — your subject holds that the duty of regional inspectors is where the root of order and disorder lies, where the court's laws and institutions reside; authority can repel overbearing strongmen, kindness can benefit orphans and widows, strength can repel treacherous bandits, government can shift customs and mores.

units.zh: 其將校曾更戰陣，及功臣子弟，請隨宜酬賞。
units.en: As for commanders and officers who have seen battle, and the sons and younger brothers of meritorious ministers — I ask that they be rewarded as appropriate.
units.literal: As for commanders and officers who have passed through battle lines, and sons and younger brothers of meritorious ministers — your subject asks that they be rewarded according to fitness.

units.zh: 茍無治人之術者，不當任此官，即絕幹禁之患矣。
units.en: If one lacks the art of governing men, he should not hold this office — then the calamity of interfering with prohibitions will end.
units.literal: If one lacks the art of governing men, he should not hold this office — then the calamity of interfering with prohibitions will be ended.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「百工淫巧，繇制度不立」者，臣請以官位祿秩制其器用車服，禁以金銀珠玉，錦繡雕鏤。
units.en: What I said about "the hundred crafts growing excessive in cleverness because institutions are not established" — I ask to regulate implements, vehicles, and dress by office rank and stipend grade, and prohibit gold, silver, pearls, jade, brocade, embroidery, and carving and inlay.
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "the hundred crafts are excessive in cleverness, because institutions are not established" — your subject asks to regulate their implements, vehicles, and dress by office rank and stipend grade, and prohibit gold, silver, pearls, jade, brocade, embroidery, and carving and inlay.

units.zh: 不蓄於私室，則無蕩心之巧矣。
units.en: If such things are not hoarded in private chambers, there will be no cleverness that unsettles the heart.
units.literal: If not stored in private chambers, there will be no cleverness that unsettles the heart.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「辨校葉」者，繇考言以詢行也；
units.en: What I called "distinguishing and comparing branches and leaves" — this is because examining words inquires into conduct;
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "distinguishing and comparing branches and leaves" — because examining words inquires into conduct;

units.zh: 臣前所謂「形於恥格」者，繇道德而齊禮也；
units.en: what I called "taking form in shame and regulation" — this is because through virtue and the Way one aligns ritual;
units.literal: what your subject earlier called "taking form in shame and regulation" — because through virtue and the Way one aligns ritual;

units.zh: 臣前所謂「念生寡而食眾，可罷斥惰遊」者，已備於前矣。
units.en: what I said about "reflecting that producers are few and consumers many, and that idle wanderers may be dismissed" — has already been set forth above.
units.literal: what your subject earlier called "reflecting that producers are few and consumers many — idle wanderers may be dismissed" — has already been set forth above.

units.zh: 臣前所謂「令煩而治鮮，要察其行否」者，臣聞號令者，治國之具也。
units.en: What I said about "orders being numerous yet governance rare, and that the essential is to examine whether they are carried out" — I have heard that commands are the instruments of governing the state.
units.literal: What your subject earlier called "orders are numerous yet governance is rare — the essential is to examine whether they are carried out" — your subject has heard that commands are the instruments of governing the state.

units.zh: 君審而出之，臣奉而行之，或虧益止留，罪在不赦。
units.en: The ruler examines and issues them; ministers receive and carry them out — to diminish, add, stop, or detain them is an unpardonable crime.
units.literal: The ruler examines and issues them; ministers receive and carry them out — to diminish, add, stop, or detain is a crime not pardoned.

units.zh: 今陛下令煩而治鮮，得非持之者有所蔽欺乎？
units.en: Today Your Majesty's orders are numerous yet governance is rare — can it be that those who hold them conceal and deceive?
units.literal: Now Your Majesty's orders are numerous yet governance is rare — can it be that those who hold them have something they conceal and deceive?

units.zh: 臣前謂「博延群彥，願陛下必納其言；
units.en: What I said earlier — "broadly gather worthy men, and I beg Your Majesty to accept their words;
units.literal: What your subject earlier said — "broadly extend to gather worthy men, and your subject wishes Your Majesty will surely accept their words;

units.zh: 造廷待問，則小臣其敢愛死」者。
units.en: come to court and await inquiry — then would this petty official dare cherish his life."
units.literal: come to court and await inquiry — then would this petty official dare cherish his life."

units.zh: 昔晁錯為漢削諸侯，非不知禍之將至，忠臣之心，壯夫之節，茍利社稷，死無悔焉。
units.en: Formerly Chao Cuo reduced the feudal lords for Han — it was not that he did not know disaster was coming; the loyal minister's heart, the stalwart's integrity: if it profits the altars of state, death brings no regret.
units.literal: Formerly Chao Cuo for Han reduced the feudal lords — it was not that he did not know disaster was about to arrive; the loyal minister's heart, the stalwart's integrity: if it profits the altars of soil and grain, death brings no regret.

units.zh: 臣非不知言發而禍應，計行而身僇，蓋痛社稷之危，哀生人之悔，豈忍姑息時忌，竊陛下一命之寵哉？
units.en: I am not unaware that when words issue disaster follows, and when plans are carried out the body is punished — I grieve the altars' peril and mourn the people's suffering: how could I bear to temporize with the times' taboos and steal one life of Your Majesty's favor?
units.literal: Your subject is not unaware that when words issue disaster responds, when plans are carried out the body is punished — broadly grieving the altars' peril, mourning the living people's suffering: how could he bear to temporize with the times' taboos and steal one life of Your Majesty's favor?

units.zh: 昔龍逄死而啟商，比幹死而啟周，韓非死而啟漢，陳蕃死而啟魏。
units.en: Formerly Long Feng died and Shang was awakened; Bi Gan died and Zhou was awakened; Han Fei died and Han was awakened; Chen Fan died and Wei was awakened.
units.literal: Formerly Long Feng died and Shang was awakened; Bi Gan died and Zhou was awakened; Han Fei died and Han was awakened; Chen Fan died and Wei was awakened.

units.zh: 今臣之來也，有司或不敢薦臣之言，陛下又無以察臣之心，退必戮於權臣之手，臣幸得從四子遊於地下，固臣之願也。
units.en: Now in my coming, the responsible offices perhaps dare not recommend my words; Your Majesty again has no means to discern my heart — on retiring I will surely be executed at the hands of powerful ministers; I would be fortunate to wander underground with the Four — that is indeed my wish.
units.literal: Now in your subject's coming, the responsible offices perhaps dare not recommend your subject's words; Your Majesty again has no means to discern your subject's heart — on retiring he will surely be executed at the hands of powerful ministers; your subject would be fortunate to wander underground with the Four — that is indeed your subject's wish.

units.zh: 所不知殺臣者，臣死之後，將孰為啟之哉！
units.en: What I do not know is: when I am killed, after my death, who will awaken them!
units.literal: What is unknown is: when your subject is killed, after your subject's death, who will awaken them!

units.zh: 至如人主之闕，政教之疵，前日之弊，臣既言之矣。
units.en: As for the ruler's faults, the flaws in government and teaching, and the abuses of former days — I have already spoken of them.
units.literal: As for the ruler's faults, the flaws in government and teaching, and the abuses of former days — your subject has already spoken of them.

units.zh: 若乃流下土之惠、脩近古之治而致和平者，在陛下行之而已。
units.en: As for spreading benefit to the lower lands, cultivating governance like that of near antiquity to attain peace — it lies in Your Majesty's carrying it out, nothing more.
units.literal: As for spreading benefit to the lower lands, cultivating near-antiquity's governance to attain peace — it lies in Your Majesty's carrying it out, nothing more.

units.zh: 然上之所陳者，實以臣親承聖問，敢不條對。
units.en: Yet what was set forth above was truly because I personally received the sage inquiry — how could I not respond item by item.
units.literal: Yet what was set forth above was truly because your subject personally received the sage inquiry — how dare he not respond item by item.

units.zh: 雖臣之愚，以為未極教化之大端、皇王之要道。
units.en: Though I am foolish, I hold that it has not reached the great beginning of transformation and teaching, the essential Way of the august kings.
units.literal: Though your subject is foolish, he holds that it has not reached the great beginning of transformation and teaching, the essential Way of the august kings.

units.zh: 伏惟陛下事天地以教人恭，奉宗廟以教人孝，養高年以教人悌長，字百姓以教人慈幼，調元氣以煦育，扇大和以仁壽，可以消搖無為，垂拱成化。
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to serve Heaven and Earth to teach reverence, attend the ancestral temples to teach filial piety, nurture the aged to teach respect for elders, cherish the people to teach kindness to the young, harmonize the vital energies to warm and nurture, fan the great harmony toward benevolence and longevity — then you may roam free in non-action, fold your arms, and let transformation be accomplished.
units.literal: I prostrate myself: may Your Majesty serve Heaven and Earth to teach men reverence, attend the ancestral temples to teach men filial piety, nurture the aged to teach men brotherly respect for elders, cherish the hundred surnames to teach men kindness to the young, harmonize the primordial qi to warm and nurture, fan the great harmony to benevolence and longevity — then you can roam free in non-action, fold your arms and let transformation be accomplished.

units.zh: 至若念陶鈞之道，在擇宰相以任之，使權造化之柄；
units.en: As for reflecting on the potter's wheel — it lies in selecting chief ministers to entrust with it, letting them wield the handle of creation and transformation;
units.literal: As for reflecting on the potter's wheel and balance — it lies in selecting chief ministers to entrust with it, letting them wield the handle of creation and transformation;

units.zh: 念保定之功，在擇將帥以任之，使脩閫外之寄；
units.en: reflecting on securing and stabilizing the realm — it lies in selecting generals and commanders to entrust with it, letting them fulfill the trust outside the frontier passes;
units.literal: reflecting on securing and stabilizing achievement — it lies in selecting generals and commanders to entrust with it, letting them cultivate the trust outside the frontier passes;

units.zh: 念百度之求正，在擇庶官面任之，使顓職業之守；
units.en: reflecting on the hundred measures' need for correctness — it lies in selecting the myriad officials and entrusting them, letting them focus on keeping to their duties;
units.literal: reflecting on the hundred measures' need for correctness — it lies in selecting the myriad officials and entrusting them, letting them focus on keeping to their duties;

units.zh: 念百姓之怨痛，在擇良吏以任之，使明惠養之術。
units.en: reflecting on the people's grievance and pain — it lies in selecting good officials to entrust with it, letting them clarify the arts of kindness and nurturing.
units.literal: reflecting on the hundred surnames' grievance and pain — it lies in selecting good officials to entrust with it, letting them clarify the arts of kindness and nurturing.

units.zh: 自然言足以為天下教，動足以為天下法，仁足以勸善，義足以禁非，又何必宵衣旰食，勞神惕慮，然後致治哉！
units.en: Then naturally your words suffice to teach the realm, your movements suffice to model it, your benevolence suffices to encourage good, your righteousness suffices to prohibit wrong — why must you rise at midnight and dine at dusk, toil your spirit and be ever vigilant, only then attain governance!
units.literal: Then naturally words suffice to be the realm's teaching, movements suffice to be the realm's model, benevolence suffices to encourage good, righteousness suffices to prohibit wrong — why must one rise at midnight and dine at dusk, toil the spirit and be vigilant in thought, only then attain governance!

units.zh: 是時，第策官左散騎常侍馮宿、太常少卿賈餗、庫部郎中龐嚴見蕡對嗟伏，以為過古晁、董，而畏中官眥睚，不敢取。
units.en: At that time the examination graders — Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Feng Su, Vice Minister of Rites Jia Su, and Bureau Director of the Storehouses Pang Yan — seeing Fen's answers sighed in admiration, holding them to surpass the ancient Chao Cuo and Dong Zhongshu; yet fearing the inner eunuchs' resentment, they dared not select him.
units.literal: At that time the examination graders — Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Feng Su, Vice Minister of Rites Jia Su, and Bureau Director of the Storehouses Pang Yan — seeing Fen's answers sighed in admiration, holding them to surpass the ancient Chao and Dong; yet fearing the inner officials' resentful glares, they dared not select him.

units.zh: 士人讀其辭，至感概流涕者。
units.en: Scholars reading his text were moved to sighing and shedding tears.
units.literal: Scholars reading his text — some were moved to sighing and shedding tears.

units.zh: 諫官御史交章論其直。
units.en: Remonstrating officials and investigating censors submitted memorial after memorial praising his straightforwardness.
units.literal: Remonstrating officials and investigating censors submitted memorials in succession discussing his straightforwardness.

units.zh: 於時，被選者二十有三人，所言皆冗齪常務，類得優調。
units.en: At that time twenty-three were selected; what they said was all redundant routine — most received favorable assignments.
units.literal: At that time those selected were twenty-three; what they said was all redundant, petty routine affairs — most received favorable assignments.

units.zh: 河南府參軍事李郃曰：「蕡逐我留，吾顏其厚邪！」
units.en: Li He, staff officer of Henan Prefecture, said: "Fen is expelled and I remain — how thick is my face!"
units.literal: Li He, staff officer of Henan Prefecture, said: "Fen is expelled and I remain — how thick is my face!"

units.zh: 乃上疏曰：「陛下禦正殿求直言，使人得自奮。
units.en: Thereupon he submitted a memorial saying: "Your Majesty held court in the main hall seeking straightforward words, enabling men to exert themselves.
units.literal: Thereupon he submitted a memorial saying: "Your Majesty held court in the main hall seeking straightforward words, enabling men to exert themselves.

units.zh: 臣才誌懦劣，不能質今古是非，使陛下聞未聞之言，行未行之事，忽忽內思，愧羞神明。
units.en: My talent and resolve are timid and inferior; I cannot verify right and wrong in past and present, cause Your Majesty to hear words never heard or carry out affairs never carried out — inwardly I am restless in thought, ashamed before the spirits.
units.literal: Your subject's talent and resolve are timid and inferior; he cannot verify right and wrong in past and present, cause Your Majesty to hear words never heard or carry out affairs never carried out — inwardly he is restless in thought, ashamed before the spirits.

units.zh: 今蕡所對，敢空臆盡言，至皇王之成敗，陛下所防閑，時政之安危，不私所料，又引《春秋》為據，漢、魏以來，無與蕡比。
units.en: Now in Fen's answers he dared empty his breast and speak fully — reaching the august kings' success and failure, what Your Majesty should guard against, the present government's safety and peril, without private calculation; again citing the Spring and Autumn Annals as evidence — since Han and Wei, none compares with Fen.
units.literal: Now in Fen's answers he dared empty his breast and speak fully — reaching the august kings' success and failure, what Your Majesty should guard against, the present government's safety and peril, without private calculation; again citing the Spring and Autumn Annals as evidence — since Han and Wei, none compares with Fen.

units.zh: 有司以言涉訐忤，不敢聞。
units.en: The responsible offices, because the words touched offense against superiors, dared not report them.
units.literal: The responsible offices, because the words touched offense against superiors, dared not report them.

units.zh: 自詔書下，萬口籍籍，嘆其誠鯁，至於垂泣，謂蕡指切左右，畏近臣銜怒，變興非常，朝野惴息，誠恐忠良道窮，綱紀遂絕，季漢之亂，復興於今。
units.en: Since the edict was issued, ten thousand mouths clamored, sighing at his sincere bluntness, even to shedding tears — saying Fen's finger pointed at those at Your Majesty's side, fearing intimate ministers would harbor anger and extraordinary change arise; court and countryside held their breath, truly fearing the loyal and good had reached a dead end, law and order were cut off, and the chaos of late Han would revive in our day.
units.literal: Since the edict was issued, ten thousand mouths were clamorous, sighing at his sincere bluntness, even to shedding tears — saying Fen's finger pointed at those at left and right, fearing intimate ministers would harbor anger and extraordinary change arise; court and countryside were anxious in breath, truly fearing the loyal and good had reached a dead end, constants and cords were cut off, and the chaos of late Han would revive in our day.

units.zh: 以陛下仁聖，近臣故無害忠良之謀；
units.en: Because Your Majesty is benevolent and sage, intimate ministers therefore have no plot to harm the loyal and good;
units.literal: Because Your Majesty is benevolent and sage, intimate ministers therefore have no plot to harm the loyal and good;

units.zh: 以宗廟威嚴，近臣故無速敗亡之禍。
units.en: because the ancestral temples are august and stern, intimate ministers therefore have no swift calamity of defeat and ruin.
units.literal: because the ancestral temples are august and stern, intimate ministers therefore have no swift calamity of defeat and ruin.

units.zh: 指事取驗，何懼直言？
units.en: Point to affairs and take verification — why fear straightforward words?
units.literal: Point to affairs and take verification — why fear straightforward words?

units.zh: 且陛下以直言召天下士，蕡以直言副陛下所問，雖訐必容，雖過當獎，書於史策，千古光明。
units.en: Moreover Your Majesty summoned scholars of the realm with a call for straightforward words; Fen answered what Your Majesty asked with straightforward words — though offensive, surely tolerate; though excessive, surely reward; written in the historical records, bright for a thousand ages.
units.literal: Moreover Your Majesty with straightforward words summoned scholars of all under Heaven; Fen with straightforward words answered what Your Majesty asked — though offensive, surely tolerate; though excessive, surely reward; written in the historical records, bright for a thousand ages.

units.zh: 使萬有一蕡不幸死，天下必曰陛下陰殺讜直，結讎海內，忠義之士，皆憚誅夷，人心一搖，無以自解。
units.en: If by ten thousand to one Fen unfortunately dies, the realm will surely say Your Majesty secretly killed the bluntly honest and knotted enmity across the empire — men of loyalty and righteousness will all fear execution; when hearts shake once, there is no means of self-explanation.
units.literal: If by ten thousand to one Fen unfortunately dies, all under Heaven will surely say Your Majesty secretly killed the bluntly honest, knotted enmity within the seas — men of loyalty and righteousness will all fear execution and extermination; when hearts shake once, there is no means of self-explanation.

units.zh: 況臣所對，不及蕡遠甚，內懷愧恥，自謂賢良，奈人言何！
units.en: Moreover my answers fall far short of Fen's; inwardly I harbor shame, calling myself worthy — yet what of men's words!
units.literal: Moreover your subject's answers fall far short of Fen's; inwardly he harbors shame, calling himself worthy — yet what of men's words!

units.zh: 乞回臣所授，以旌蕡直。
units.en: I beg to return what was conferred on me, to display Fen's straightforwardness.
units.literal: Your subject begs to return what was conferred on him, to display Fen's straightforwardness.

units.zh: 臣逃茍且之慚，朝有公正之路，陛下免天下之疑，顧不美哉！」
units.en: I escape the shame of temporizing; the court has a path of fairness; Your Majesty frees the realm's doubts — is it not beautiful!"
units.literal: Your subject escapes the shame of temporizing; the court has a path of fairness; Your Majesty frees all under Heaven's doubts — is it not beautiful!"

units.zh: 帝不納。
units.en: The emperor did not accept.
units.literal: The emperor did not accept.

units.zh: 郃字子玄，後歷賀州刺史。
units.en: He was styled Zixuan; later he served as prefect of He Prefecture.
units.literal: He was styled Zixuan; later he served as prefect of He Prefecture.

units.zh: 蕡對後七年，有甘露之難。
units.en: Seven years after Fen's answers came the Sweet Dew calamity.
units.literal: Seven years after Fen's answers came the Sweet Dew calamity.

units.zh: 令狐楚、牛僧孺節度山南東西道，皆表蕡幕府，授秘書郎，以師禮禮之。
units.en: Linghu Chu and Niu Sengru, as military commissioners of the eastern and western circuits south of the mountains, both memorialized for Fen to join their staffs, appointed him Secretary Gentleman, and treated him with the rites due a teacher.
units.literal: Linghu Chu and Niu Sengru, as military commissioners of the eastern and western circuits south of the mountains, both memorialized for Fen in their staffs, appointed him Secretary Gentleman, and treated him with the rites due a teacher.

units.zh: 而宦人深嫉蕡，誣以罪，貶柳州司戶參軍，卒。
units.en: Yet the eunuchs deeply resented Fen, falsely charged him with a crime, demoted him to Revenue Assistant of Liuzhou, and he died.
units.literal: Yet the eunuchs deeply resented Fen, falsely charged him with crime, demoted him to Revenue Assistant of Liuzhou, and he died.

units.zh: 始，帝恭儉求治，誌除兇人，然懦而不睿，臣下畏禍不敢言，故蕡對極陳晉襄公殺陽處父以戒帝，又引閽弒吳子，陰贊帝決。
units.en: At the beginning the emperor was respectful and frugal in seeking governance, resolved to remove vicious men — yet timid and not perspicacious; ministers feared disaster and dared not speak; therefore in his answers Fen fully set forth how Duke Xiang of Jin killed Yang Chufu to warn the emperor, and again cited how a gate guard murdered the Prince of Wu, secretly urging the emperor's resolve.
units.literal: At the beginning the emperor was respectful and frugal in seeking governance, resolved to remove vicious men — yet timid and not perspicacious; ministers feared disaster and dared not speak; therefore in his answers Fen fully set forth how Duke Xiang of Jin killed Yang Chufu to warn the emperor, and again cited how a gate guard murdered the Prince of Wu, secretly urging the emperor's resolve.

units.zh: 帝後與宋申錫謀誅守澄不克，守澄廢帝弟漳王而斥申錫，帝依違其間，不敢主也。
units.en: Later the emperor with Song Shenxi plotted to execute Shoucheng but did not succeed; Shoucheng deposed the emperor's younger brother the Prince of Zhang and expelled Shenxi — the emperor wavered between them and dared not take the lead.
units.literal: Later the emperor with Song Shenxi plotted to execute Shoucheng but did not succeed; Shoucheng deposed the emperor's younger brother the Prince of Zhang and expelled Shenxi — the emperor wavered between them and dared not take the lead.

units.zh: 賈餗與王涯、李訓、舒元輿位宰相，以謀敗，皆為中官夷其宗，而宦者益橫，帝以憂崩。
units.en: Jia Su with Wang Ya, Li Xun, and Shu Yuanyu held the chief ministership; when the plot failed, all were exterminated in their clans by the eunuchs — and the eunuchs grew more overbearing; the emperor died of grief.
units.literal: Jia Su with Wang Ya, Li Xun, and Shu Yuanyu held the chief ministership; when the plot failed, all were exterminated in their clans by inner officials — and the eunuchs grew more overbearing; the emperor died of grief.

units.zh: 及昭宗誅韓全誨等，左拾遺羅袞上言：「蕡當太和時，宦官始熾，因直言策請奪爵土，復掃除之役，遂罹譴逐，身死異土，六十餘年，正人義夫切齒飲泣。
units.en: When Emperor Zhaozong executed Han Quanhui and others, Left Reminder Luo Gun submitted words: "In the Taihe era, when eunuchs were just growing fierce, Fen in his straightforward examination answers asked to strip them of noble ranks and fiefs and restore the task of sweeping them away — thereby he suffered reprimand and exile and died in a foreign land; for more than sixty years upright men and men of righteousness gnashed their teeth and wept.
units.literal: When Emperor Zhaozong executed Han Quanhui and others, Left Reminder Luo Gun submitted words: "When Fen was in the Taihe era, eunuchs were just growing fierce; because of his straightforward examination answers he asked to strip them of noble ranks and fiefs and restore the sweeping-away task — thereby he suffered reprimand and exile, died in a foreign land; for more than sixty years upright men and men of righteousness gnashed teeth and drank tears.

units.zh: 比陛下幽東內，幸西州，王室幾喪。
units.en: Compared with Your Majesty confined in the eastern inner quarters and fortunate to reach the western capital — the royal house nearly perished.
units.literal: Compared with Your Majesty confined in the eastern inner quarters, fortunate to reach the western capital — the royal house nearly perished.

units.zh: 使蕡策早用，則杜漸防萌，逆節可消，寧殷憂多難，遠及聖世耶！
units.en: If Fen's policy had been used early, gradual advance would have been blocked and sprouts prevented, rebellious conduct could have been eliminated — how could deep sorrow and many hardships extend so far as to reach a sage age!
units.literal: If Fen's policy had been used early, then gradual advance would have been blocked and sprouts prevented, rebellious conduct could have been eliminated — how could deep sorrow and many hardships extend so far as to reach a sage age!

units.zh: 今天地反正，枉魄憤胔，有望於陛下。」
units.en: Now Heaven and Earth have returned to correctness; wronged souls rage in their flesh — they look to Your Majesty."
units.literal: Now Heaven and Earth have returned to correctness; wronged souls rage in their flesh — they look to Your Majesty."

units.zh: 帝感悟，贈蕡左諫議大夫，訪子孫授以官雲。
units.en: The emperor was moved to understanding, posthumously conferred on Fen the title Left Remonstrator of the Palace, sought out his descendants and conferred offices on them.
units.literal: The emperor was moved to understanding, posthumously conferred on Fen Left Remonstrator of the Palace, sought out his descendants and conferred offices on them.

units.zh: 贊曰：漢武帝三策董仲舒，仲舒所對，陳天人大概，緩而不切也。
units.en: The encomium says: Emperor Wu of Han thrice examined Dong Zhongshu; what Dong answered set forth the great outline of Heaven and man — leisurely and not incisive.
units.literal: The encomium says: Emperor Wu of Han thrice examined Dong Zhongshu; what Dong answered set forth the great outline of Heaven and man — leisurely and not incisive.

units.zh: 蕡與諸儒偕進，獨譏切宦官，然亦太疏直矣。
units.en: Fen advanced together with the other scholars, alone speaking sharply against the eunuchs — yet he was also too blunt and direct.
units.literal: Fen advanced together with the various scholars, alone sharply criticizing the eunuchs — yet he was also too blunt and direct.

units.zh: 戒帝漏言，而身誦語於廷，何邪？
units.en: He warned the emperor against leaking secrets, yet himself spoke his full mind in open court — how contradictory?
units.literal: He warned the emperor against leaking words, yet himself declaimed his words in court — how is this?

units.zh: 其後宋申錫以謀泄貶，李訓以計不臧死，宦者遂強，可不戒哉！
units.en: Afterward Song Shenxi was demoted when his plot leaked, Li Xun died when his scheme failed — the eunuchs then grew strong; should this not serve as a warning!
units.literal: Afterward Song Shenxi was demoted when the plot leaked, Li Xun died when the plan was not good — the eunuchs then grew strong; should this not be a warning!

units.zh: 意蕡之賢，當先以忠結上，後為帝謀天下所以安危者，庶其紓患耶！
units.en: One thinks that with Fen's talent, he ought first to win the sovereign's trust through loyalty, then counsel the emperor on what secures or endangers the realm — perhaps then he might have eased the calamity!
units.literal: One thinks that with Fen's worth, he ought first to bind the sovereign with loyalty, then afterward plot for the emperor what brings security and danger to all under Heaven — perhaps then he could have relieved the trouble!
